chars.summary: Worked from the unit's description (not the game sprites). A flying larva about 23×22, hovering 8 cells up. Parts: pale-teal segmented soft body, a bone-white voodoo mask wider than the body (3 purple plumes on top, bone spike on the brow), two pairs of thin see-through insect wings, and a purple sac under the belly showing glowing green poison. Attack: mask headbutt, lunging 5 cells. Skill (the Allergic Reaction death-trigger trait): the sac swells in 3 steps and the eye holes glow purple, then it leans back for one frame and lobs a 2×2 poison ball in an arc. On hit: poison cloud, poison tint on the target, and a small purple skull above its head. Death: wings stop, the sac bursts (engine burst death), the mask flies off and lands on its back, and poison clouds drift toward the killer. Sound declaration: flesh / explode / poison / poison, weight 0.2, hover. shoot.mjs exit 0, compare.mjs exit 0 (closest silhouette overlap about 0.40), first 4 walk frames all different. One fix round (moved and narrowed the wings, recolored the wings so the body reads, moved the rim-light source to the sac); compare --prev shows only these intended changes.

Grown form of the Believer, about 28×26, hovering 7 cells up. Keeps the same body color, wings and mask, and adds: an indigo shell over the back (half-open, rear edge flared, 3 open levels), the mask enlarged to 8×10 with a crown of 5 bone spikes, a pair of mantis scythe claws (serrated inner edge, green poison tips), and two bead-shaped sacs. Attack: both claws sweep across each other, drawn as two crossing slash arcs. Skill (the Secondary Allergic Reaction trait): backs off 4 cells, opens the shell fully, lights the rear sac then the front sac, and poison gathers at the claw tips. It then swings both claws in an X and throws two poison blades that cross in flight. Each blade leaves a deep poison cloud; the target is tinted and slowed, gets an X-shaped poison mark, and poison drops form a puddle at its feet. Death: wings fold and it drops straight down, lands with dust, the shell breaks into pieces (engine chunks death), then the two sacs burst one after the other. Sound declaration: armor / shatter / poison / blade, weight 0.45, hover. shoot.mjs exit 0, compare.mjs exit 0 against reference, accepted and the Believer (overlap with the Believer about 0.52), first 4 walk frames all different. Two fix rounds (wing roots moved under the shell so they show, claw rest pose changed to a V with a longer blade, weaker shell-break force); compare --prev shows only these intended changes.

built.feedback: 1）分配要求用 B.fly 身体 + B.wing 膜翅，但 B.fly 的身体只有鸟头 / 蝙蝠头两种卵形体，B.wing 膜翅是蝙蝠翼指形，都画不出「分节软虫身 + 细长透明昆虫膜翅」，所以自己写了 insectWing，身体用 util 画笔画。建议非人形部件库加一种昆虫翅（B.wing 加 type 'insect'）和一种分节虫身。2）parts-beast.md 第一节把 VoodooBeliever / VoodooGuard 归在「边界：按人形处理」，但它们的描述更像飞虫，这一条容易误导。3）B.wing 画在部件内部，没法对翼面做隔点透光（后画的像素不知道哪些是翼面）；如果部件能返回像素覆盖范围或者提供 dither 选项，就能做出半透翅。4）shoot.mjs 在输出目录里建 .chrome 浏览器配置目录，跑完不会自动删。5）弹道 shoot() 没有重力，要做抛物线毒弹只能在模块里自己写一套弹道和命中计时；建议 shoot 的 o 参数加 g（重力）。

chars.summary: 游侠（精灵射手·普通）：slim 瘦高体，苔绿尖顶兜帽+长兜帽尾+向后伸出的精灵长尖耳，27 格浅木长弓竖在身前，背后高箭袋（白羽束高出肩线）。攻击=1 帧拉满后直射（钢头木杆绿羽箭）；技能「精准」=半蹲拉弓不放，银色隔点瞄准线+假人身上逐帧收缩的菱形准星 → 松弦定格 2 帧射出 1×5 白刃光箭（震屏 2 格+闪白）→ 命中星芒+斜切口，0.2 s 后第二道交叉裂口（两段各一次 impact）→ 收招从箭袋再抽一支箭。待机个性：抽箭举到眼前吹箭羽；步态：轻快小跑；死亡：前扑，弓弹到身前，两支箭散落。steel 色阶，SFX metal/blade 0.25。shoot 退出码 0、compare 退出码 0、gaitEvery2 前 4 帧各不相同。产出 pcd/chars/Ranger.js、pcd/batch-09/Ranger/design.md、pcd/batch-09/Ranger/shots/

死亡射手（精灵射手·稀有，由游侠进化）：同款兜帽/尖耳/兜帽尾/箭袋，加高到约 28 格、待机半蹲前倾；破边长披风垂到脚边（墨黑绿+墨紫暗部），骨白骷髅面罩，14 格高骨箭袋插紫羽黑箭，反曲骨弓（缠布弓臂+两端外翻骨刺钩）+弦上紫色标记石（发光体，5 档）。攻击=1 帧预兆后快速连射两箭；技能「标记目标」=紫色符文粒子绕弓臂收拢、假人头顶浮现靶心符 → 扇形三连射（第 3 支震屏 2 格+闪白）→ 每支命中在靶心外加一圈（12→9→6 越收越紧），最后一圈诅咒外爆+冲击环+steel 斜切+dummyFx 诅咒染色描边 → 收招面罩下呼出紫雾。待机个性：空拉弓弦试弦；步态：潜行不起尘；死亡：单膝跪地、弓立身前 → death ash（curse）化灰，空披风塌落后消散。curse 色阶，SFX curse/spiral 0.35。shoot 退出码 0、compare 退出码 0（与游侠对比也不判重），compare --prev 只报了有意改动的弓位。产出 pcd/chars/DeathShooter.js、pcd/batch-09/DeathShooter/design.md、pcd/batch-09/DeathShooter/shots/

built.feedback: 1) parts.bow 的弦和弓臂几乎重合（bend 1.6 时两者只差 0–1 格），深色弓臂在夜景里被浅色弦盖住，远看只剩一根弦；死亡射手因此自己画了弯度更深的弓。建议库里的 bow 加一个 bend/curve 参数。2) parts.bow 只画一个 wood 材质，没法加镶片 / 缠布（设定里写的白桦镶片只能省掉）。3) parts.pack 的 quiver 长度和箭数是固定的，要更高的箭袋只能在模块里复制一份。4) 旁注：scratchpad 目录由同一会话的并行代理共用，我的临时 crop.py 被别的代理覆盖过一次，后来改用带前缀的子目录才避开。

chars.summary: 赤卫（精灵·先锋·优质，22×26）：孩童比例重甲（child rig，大护鼻尖盔），盔顶高红缨，背后两团粉红布裹着的翅芽鼓包（候选部件 wingBud），左臂赤红鸢形盾，盾心是暗红十字结晶（发光体），身上有绷带和 3 道裂伤。攻击：从盾沿上方单手平刺叶形短矛，带刺痕和残影。技能「细胞再生」：蓄力时裂伤由下往上变亮，脚下升起红粉小十字；施放时心跳般的小环接大环，裂伤合拢成白线，翅芽鼓动；命中时头顶飘出红粉十字，轮廓描边闪 3 次。死亡：后仰倒地，红缨先着地，盾压在胸前，裹布散开一角。shoot 退出码 0，compare 退出码 0（最接近维京战士，idleIoU 0.687），compare --prev 退出码 0。产出在 pcd/chars/RedGuard.js 和 pcd/batch-09/RedGuard/（design.md、shots）。

圣光骑士（精灵·圣骑士·史诗，32×39，悬停离地 4 格）：赤卫的成熟体，保留红缨尖盔和鸢形盾，叶形矛长成翼形护手的圣光长枪。背后是白金大羽翼（B.wing feather，翼尖挂赤卫的红布条），盔后上方有悬浮光环（候选部件 halo），银白板甲配红罩袍。攻击：从空中升高再斜下俯冲突刺，带金色残影和枪身光束。技能「超级细胞再生」：蓄力时羽翼张到最大，脚下金色法阵，羽光向盾心十字收拢；施放时光柱落在自己身上，羽翼猛扇，金羽外爆；命中时连续升起金色十字（数量和速度都是赤卫的两倍），全身 holy 轮廓光，旧伤痕化为金线后消失。移动是滑翔（hover），死亡是羽翼垂落、坠地前扑，盾先落地、长枪后落地，最后化成金色光点上升。shoot 退出码 0，compare 退出码 0（和赤卫比较也通过），compare --prev 退出码 0。产出在 pcd/chars/HolyLightKnight.js 和 pcd/batch-09/HolyLightKnight/。

built.feedback: 1) B.wing 不返回翼尖坐标，要在翼尖挂东西只能把它的几何在模块里重算一遍，建议让 B.wing 返回 tips。2) B.wing 直接调 E.sp 画在精灵坐标里，不走人形 rig 的落笔变换，所以人形加翅膀倒地时要自己用 parts.toSprite 换算翼根，README 里没提这一点。3) 部件库的 begin 示例写的是 begin(hero, P.bx, -P.lift)，但 rig 倒地时 R.oy 已经含了 lift，两边一起用会让离地高度算两次，建议在 README 里写清楚。4) 截图脚本固定截 1600×900，角色只占画面一小块，每次都得自己裁图放大看细节。

chars.summary: Round, squat baby dragon, about 37×21 cells. Built on quad with a dragon head scaled up and short horns. Four pink buds along the spine (the tallest sticks 4 cells above the back and opens slightly with each breath). One leaf-shaped wing folded on the back, and a flower at the tail tip. Attack: lunges forward 5 cells and bites, with two jaw arcs closing. Skill 芬芳 (Fragrance): chest swells on the in-breath, buds bloom one by one from back to front, and pink/yellow-green pollen spirals inward. On release the flowers jolt, a pink-green fragrance ring spreads along the ground to both sides with puffs of mist, and petals fall. The dummy is wrapped in mist, then shows the fragrance tint, slows down and keeps bubbling. Idle: sniffs the flowers and sneezes out pollen. Walk: waddling trot. Death: rolls onto its side with legs out, buds close and petals scatter. SFX declared: nature/poison, weight 0.35. shoot.mjs exit 0, compare.mjs exit 0 (closest match 蛮兵, IoU 0.58), gaitEvery2 frames 0,2,4,6 all distinct, no custom colours added.

Grown heavy dragon, about 53×28 cells (len 16, shoulder hump, low stance). Evolves EmeraldDragon: keeps the back flowers, leaf wing and tail flower. The main back flower becomes a large purple-black rotting flower behind the shoulder, with 3 small poison flowers behind it. The leaf wing becomes a large dead-leaf wing with holes. It also gains a glowing green throat sac and a pair of swept-back horns. Attack: rears back and inflates the sac, then spits a poison glob that leaves a small cloud. Skill 毒气 (Poison Gas): crouches low with wings half open, the sac inflates one step at a time and glows, the flower sucks mist back into its centre, and green seams light up between the scales. On release it rears up, a half-ring of purple spores fires from the back flower, then it sprays a poison wave along the ground. At the dummy a bubbling swamp forms and the dummy takes the poison tint, sinks 1 cell and slows. Death: melts using the engine's death kit, and the flower falls onto the sludge last as a separate pre-rendered sprite. SFX declared: poison/nova, weight 0.8. shoot.mjs exit 0, compare.mjs exit 0, compare --prev exit 3 not triggered (nothing disappeared), gaitEvery2 frames all distinct, no custom colours added.

partsAdded: leafWing (leaf-shaped wing, in both modules; holes option for the dead leaf)
spineFlowers (flower buds along the spine, EmeraldDragon)
tailFlower (flower at the tail tip)
rotFlower (large rotting flower, PoisonDragon)
throatSac (glowing throat sac, PoisonDragon)
built.feedback: 1) The quad part library has no hook for tail-tip coordinates, so each module copies quad.tail's stepping loop to place the flower. A B.quad.tailTip(rig,P,o) would fix that. 2) After lie 2 with lieLegs:1 the body flips belly-up and the back ends up on the ground side, so anything growing from the spine (flowers, ridge spikes) has nowhere sensible to be drawn. The docs don't cover this case. 3) The death kit's melt snapshot takes every pixel of the sprite. To make one part (the back flower) fall last on its own, I had to add a nofl key field that drops it from the snapshot and then pre-render it as a separate small sprite. A "leave these parts out and hand them back as a separate sprite" option in melt would be simpler. 4) The workflow's subagents share one scratchpad directory. My crop.py was overwritten by another agent partway through, and I had to move my files into a subdirectory. The task text should tell each agent to use its own subdirectory.

chars.summary: 黑铁卫：巨型重装精灵（giant 改，约 31 格 + 背旗，待机 34×41），黑铁板甲 + 桶盔冷蓝眼光 + 一对亮银叶形翼耳 + 背后插的三角旗（旗杆离背 3 格、两道杆托）+ 身前 9×14 尖顶塔盾（三刺、银叶纹、冷银盾钉 5 档）。攻击是双手举盾过头再砸地（银弧 + 地裂）。技能「厚皮」：蓄力时举盾、旗被拉直、金属屑收拢；施放时盾插进地里，银点阵护罩罩住自己和身后友军，旗杆顶连线，每个友军胸前落一枚铁盾印。待机会顿盾；重步行走时盾磕地。死亡：跪地以盾撑住，死亡套件 parts 让盔、肩甲、旗散开，塔盾最后向后倒下。SFX armor/collapse/metal/shield 0.9。shoot 退出码 0（验收通过，没有专属色）；compare 退出码 0（最接近赌徒寡妇，IoU 0.61）；移动 gaitEvery2 前 4 个编号各不相同；--prev 里消失的区域都是有意改的（翼耳、旗杆、施放姿）。自检做了 3 轮。

翠盾：黑铁卫进化后的同一个人（giant 改，约 35 格，待机 37×48），翠绿活木板甲 + 黑铁盔、臂甲、胫甲。翼耳沿用同款，缠了藤、尖端多一片大叶。背后的旗杆长成小树：头顶后上方一团树冠，枝上挂一面竖长的议会旗。塔盾放大到 11×16：黑铁框、暗翠玉面，顶上三根抽芽木刺，盾心翠玉花开合 3 档 × 发光 5 档。脚下有根须，腰间一圈藤叶腰带。攻击是根刺盾砸（fx.wave 根刺 + 翠弧）。技能「议会」：蓄力时盾插地、根须两次放射、叶片汇聚、花慢慢开；施放时人向后仰、双层 fx.circle 大法阵、叶片外爆；命中时藤蔓连到每个友军，友军脚下长出小藤、身前一片片展开 8×9 叶盾。待机花开合、偶尔落叶；行走时每步冒草芽。死亡：跪地撑盾，藤蔓分 3 档裹住全身，再用死亡套件 ash（nature）化成落叶。SFX armor/dissolve/nature/buff 0.95。shoot 退出码 0；compare 退出码 0（对照已通过角色和黑铁卫，最接近黑铁卫 IoU 0.649，低于判重阈值）；gaitEvery2 通过；--prev 只少了 1 格，是有意挪动的嫩叶。自检做了 2 轮。

built.feedback: 1) parts.shield 的 tower 只有 13 行、半宽 3，而且顶边不能加齿或尖刺，两个角色只好各自画塔盾；建议库里的 shield 支持 h / w / 顶饰参数。2) parts.px 不会画进 y > 0 的像素，单独烤掉落物（比如倒下的盾）时锚点必须放在底边，README 只在「约定」里提了一句，容易踩坑。3) 引擎没有导出带颜色的 blit（只有 blitShape 单色剪影），死亡时单独画一张彩色小精灵（盾最后倒下）要自己用 put 循环，建议导出 blit。4) frames.mjs 的逐帧图按 bbox 裁切，帧宽不固定，想放大某一帧不方便；我是用 --grid 和 shoot 的全屏截图代替的。5) 目前没有角色用过 ALLIES / allyFx，README 里没有示例；allyPoints 的 mid / top 挂点能用，但近战站位时友军在身后，护罩和法阵的圆心要自己挪到自己和友军之间，才不会罩到敌人身上，值得在说明里写一句。

chars.summary: 玉藤堡垒：自画的玉青石方塔（4 个雉堞，顶上一簇香蕉叶），塔身缠着带白倒刺的深绿藤，下面两条树根腿，右侧一只长藤臂卷着一串扇形香蕉。攻击是藤臂后甩再抡出，抛物线投一根香蕉。技能是倒刺：挨一颗敌弹后倒刺一根根竖起、绿汁往命中点汇聚，然后扇形射出 5 根绿刺，钉在假人身上排成一竖排。死亡时塔身开裂，碎成一地玉块（chunks），香蕉串滚出来。shoot 退出码 0，compare 退出码 0（最接近的是寡妇，待机 IoU 0.667），compare --prev 退出码 0，gaitEvery2 前 4 个编号各不相同。追加了 3 个玉色专属色。

风暴堡垒：玉藤堡垒长大后的两层塔（下宽上窄；上层就是同款 15 格雉堞塔身），保留香蕉叶、射孔眼光、藤臂和香蕉。新加的有：灰青风暴石、刺尖电蓝的粗荆棘、3 只各挂一串香蕉的藤臂（右、左、背后举过顶），塔顶悬一团雷云。攻击是三只藤臂轮流抡，一次连投 3 根香蕉（部落战争）。技能：两颗敌弹打上来，荆棘逐根亮起、雷云压低蓄电，然后射出 8 根带电刺，同时雷云劈出 3 道闪电，假人眩晕。死亡时雷云散成雨丝，香蕉串甩飞，上层塔逐行后歪再断开倒地，最后化成碎石（chunks）。shoot 退出码 0，compare 退出码 0（最接近的是邪眼王，施放 IoU 0.601；和玉藤堡垒互比待机 IoU 0.553），gaitEvery2 前 4 个编号各不相同。追加了 3 个风暴石专属色。

built.feedback: 1) parts-beast.md 把「塔 / 树」标成「未做」，还没有任何建筑或植物的范例；第一次得自己摸索怎么画大方块，才能不和藤蔓之间压出分界线（藤蔓单独成部件时，两侧的玉石都被压成了勾线色）。建议在 README 里加一句：贴在大面积上的装饰（藤、裂纹、纹路）和大面积画在同一个 part 里。2) 引擎的弹道没有重力，弹道池也只有 6 个槽，所以抛物线投掷和 8 根刺弹都得在模块里自己养一套抛射物；可以考虑在 shoot 的选项里加 g（重力）并把池子放大。3) 神话级带顶饰的角色很容易超过待机高度 48 的上限（风暴堡垒第一版是 51 格），标准里可以写明神话 / Boss 的高度预算包含浮空部件。4) 各个工作流代理共用同一个 scratchpad 目录，我放在里面的 crop.py 被别的代理覆盖了；建议给每个代理分一个子目录。

suggestions: IDLE: the lowest point is at y=-4 (4 cells off the ground) but the design card says 8. Raise the whole body by 3-4 cells so it reads more clearly as a flying unit.
DEATH: the mask bounces off and lands, but no sfx('fall') fires. Add sfx('fall', {w:0.2}) on the frame the mask hits the ground (about 0.8 s).

Mask: in silhouette the round face with its C-shaped eye holes reads like a snail shell. Make the vertical 7x9 oval and the 3 feathers more distinct, and keep the forehead bone spike sticking 1 cell out of the outline, so the mask-as-shield reads as a vanguard.
review.note: shoot exit code 0 with no problems; compare exit code 0 (closest match: nun, idle IoU 0.505). The burst death leaves an empty final pose while the mask lands and the poison cloud drifts toward the killer, which fits the design. Skill: the sac swells over the charge, a large poison blob is released, and the target turns poison-green with a purple skull above it. It is clearly readable.

suggestions: IDLE: the lowest point is y=-2, nearly touching the ground, while the design card says 7 cells up. Raise it by 3-4 cells so it still reads as a flying unit.
SKILL cast: make the two crossed poison blade arcs of the X larger (2 cells wide, reaching the target's outline in the first frame) so the X shape reads from the cast frame alone.
The mask is only a little larger than the Believer's. Push it toward the design's 8x10 and make the bone-spike crown rise 3 cells so the upgrade line reads better.
review.note: shoot exit code 0; compare exit code 0 (closest match: watchman, idle IoU 0.556). The purple domed shell, bone mask, sickle claws and poison sacs keep the same identity as the Believer after evolving. The fall-and-shatter death (fall at 0.933 s plus chunks) is clearly different from the Believer's mid-air burst. The sfx swing/hit land on the strike frame.

suggestions: ATTACK / SKILL cast: the drawn-bow pose lasts only 1 frame (ATTACK frame 1). At the release frame (frame 2) the bow snaps straight back to the idle vertical position, so the release barely differs from idle. Keep the bow arm extended horizontally toward the target for frames 2-3 and show the string vibrating (a 1-cell offset) before easing back.

Idle bow: the stave is a 3-cell straight plank with only a 1-cell bend, and in silhouette it reads like a board. Add 2-3 cells of curve to each limb tip (bending backward) so it reads as a longbow at a glance.
Death: the bow flies to x=48, which is quite far. A landing point around x=20-25 would look more natural.
review.note: shoot exit code 0; compare exit code 0 (closest match: star wizard, idle IoU 0.631). The two gait contact frames swap feet (shown by the depth tone), and the step sfx lands on frames 0/4/8/12/16. Skill: aim line plus diamond reticle, then a blade arrow, then a second slash cut. Fits the Precision trait.

suggestions: MOVE: the long cape covers the legs, so the two contact frames (MOVE:0 and MOVE:4) differ by only 1 cell in foot position and the silhouette barely shows the foot swap. Let the front foot stick out 1-2 cells past the cape hem, with the near and far feet at different x positions.

Skill charge: show the bow drawn with a clear difference from the attack draw, for example a deeper crouch of 1 more cell or the bow held higher, so the charge pose and the rapid double-shot attack are easier to tell apart.
review.note: shoot exit code 0; compare exit code 0 against the accepted library (closest match: star wizard, idle IoU 0.692). A pairwise compare against Ranger in the same upgrade line gives idle IoU 0.78, below the 0.82 threshold, so it can be accepted alongside Ranger. The recurve bone bow with hooked tips, the ragged-hem long cape, the lower-face bone mask and the purple mark stone are all present. Attack: two quick shots, each with shoot/swing on its release frame. Skill: a reticle is added and tightens, the target turns curse-purple, and ash death leaves the empty cape behind.

suggestions: MOVE：接触帧现在已换脚（MOVE:0 暗靴在后、亮靴在前，MOVE:4 对调，腿露出 3–4 行），但胸甲下摆仍压到 y−4，可以再短 1 行，让胫甲读得更清楚。
SKILL 施放：胸口心跳冲击环的粉色块较大，盖住了半个上身，可以把小环缩 1–2 格，或改成空心环。
翅芽包的红布可以再加一道 1 格宽的白绷带横缠，让「裹着」更好读。
review.note: shoot=0、compare=0（最接近的是诅咒剑士，idleIoU 0.747，没有被判撞脸）。上一轮 MOVE 的阻断问题已修好，--grid 核对过两只靴子的色阶和前后位置都对调了，经过帧抬起的脚也露出来了。compare --prev 退出码 3，但消失的部分都是按上一轮要求上移的翅芽（x−16..−7），不是部件丢失。sfx 的 step 在 f0/4/8/12/16，对上接触帧；swing/hit 在攻击 f2（伸展帧）；fall 落在倒地。已复制到 accepted/RedGuard。

suggestions: DEATH：现在是整体倒地后用抖点溶解，设定写的是「羽毛一片片散开后化成金色光点上升」。可以在倒地后的帧里加 4–6 片羽毛粒子，并让 holy 色光点往上飘。
MOVE：滑翔时没有步声，这是合理的；可以在翼姿 3（下扇帧）挂一个轻的扇翼 sfx，和设定里的「羽翼扇风呼啦」对应。
翼尖的红布条现在只有 1×3 的一小点，可以再长 1 格，远翼也补一条，让它和赤卫的红布呼应得更明显。
review.note: shoot=0、compare=0（最接近的是魔王近卫，idleIoU 0.566）。上一轮的三条阻断问题都已修好：(1) 羽片主体是白 / 奶白，金色只在暗侧和翼缘，不再是卡其色的毛团；(2) 翼尖红布条是翼尖往下垂的细条，不再是红方块；(3) 待机时远翼伸出头盔上沿（bbox y−52），两片翼在剪影上分开；蓄力 bbox 扩到 x−38、y−59，比待机明显变宽、变高，翼姿 5 张到最大。compare --prev 退出码 3，但这是翅膀按要求上移的重绘（新增 148 格、消失 51 格），不是部件丢失。升级线和赤卫一致：红缨尖盔、鸢形盾、红布残片都保留了。已复制到 accepted/HolyLightKnight。

suggestions: 叶片小膜翼：近翼贴在身侧，在身体上压出一片深色网格分界线，读成身上的杂线，剪影里也看不到翅膀。建议近翼收在背上，往背线上方翘出 2–3 格，形状清楚的叶片放在花脊后面；身侧的分界线会随之减少。
设定是『圆滚、胸臀圆』，现在的体形更接近剑龙式的长方身，可以把胸和臀各鼓出 1 格。
review.note: shoot=0，compare=0（color 0.008，和已通过的角色撞色风险很低），audit 没有问题，sfx 帧位正确。背上花苞脊、尾花、嗅花打喷嚏的待机、四足小跑、咬合、花朵绽放 + 贴地粉绿香雾环 + 假人染毒变慢的技能、侧翻伸腿 + 花苞合拢的死亡都到位，已复制到 accepted/EmeraldDragon/sprite-lite.json。

suggestions: 头顶后掠长角现在是一整块骨白色的粗棒，从后脑往右上翘，看起来像背上横着一根骨头。建议改成两根 1–2 格宽、逐渐变细的角，从头顶往后掠，尖端分叉错开 2 格。
破洞枯叶大翼在待机和移动里完全看不到（只有施放时才出现黄绿色的网格翼），设定写的是『半张时伸出背线 8 格』。可以让待机里也露出 3–4 格翼尖。
巨花中心那道横向黄绿色缝读起来像一只眼睛。可以改成花心凹陷 + 放射状的暗色花瓣纹。
死亡用的是死亡套件 melt，sprite.json 的 DEATH 帧在 0.8 s 后一直停在站姿，这是 deathKit 的已知行为，已记录在导出里；画面里（8_death_down / 9_death_dissolve）的融化和蒸发是正确的。
review.note: shoot=0，compare=0，audit 没有问题（deathKit melt @0.8），sfx 的 step / swing / shoot / hit / fall 帧位正确。和翡翠龙的升级线一致（花脊 → 紫毒花脊，尾花 → 紫尾花，放大到 53×28，喉囊发荧光）。喉囊鼓动的待机、沉重爬行、毒息、喉囊鼓满 + 巨花吸雾 → 毒息浪 + 紫孢子 + 毒沼下陷的技能都达标，已复制到 accepted/PoisonDragon/sprite-lite.json。

suggestions: IDLE：塔盾高约 14 格，只到身高的一半左右，读不出分配里写的「几乎与身同高」。可以把盾面加高 3–4 格（整盾约 17–18 格），盾顶尖刺的位置跟着上移。
MOVE：两个接触帧在纯黑剪影里换脚不够明显。可以把远侧那条腿的接触位置再拉开 1 格，让两腿之间的缝在 f0 和 f2 的位置明显不同。
review.note: shoot=0、compare=0（最接近的是赌徒寡妇，待机 IoU 0.61），frames=0。剪影里塔盾三刺、铁翼护耳、背后三角旗都看得清。盾砸有拖影、地裂和星芒。技能有塔盾插地、银点阵护罩罩住友军、给友军落小铁盾印。死亡是跪地撑盾，然后按 parts 散架（盔、旗、肩甲飞出）。sfx 的 step 在 f0/4/8，swing/hit 在出手帧 f2，fall 在 0.683 s 落地帧，都对得上。

suggestions: IDLE/全状态：近侧叶形翼耳斜着向上插进树冠，剪影里和树冠连成一片，看不出翼耳这个识别特征。可以把翼耳改成向后水平伸出（尖端朝左后方，在树冠下沿以下），或者让树冠整体上移 2 格，留出 ≥3 格的空隙。
SKILL 施放：身体姿势和蓄力几乎一样，设定卡写的「向后挺身仰头」看不出来。可以在施放两帧里让躯干后仰 1 格、头上抬 1 格、树冠后摆 1 档。
review.note: shoot=0、compare=0（最接近的是赌徒寡妇，0.504）。和黑铁卫明显是同一条升级线：保留三刺塔盾、翼耳盔和背上的杆，杆长成树，主色换成翠绿，个子也更大。技能命中很有辨识度：大圆法阵、藤蔓连线、每个友军身前长出叶盾。死亡是跪地、藤蔓分 3 档裹身，然后 ash 化成落叶。音效时间点正确。

suggestions: IDLE：塔顶的香蕉叶盖住了垛口之间的缝，纯黑剪影里 4 个雉堞只剩起伏的一团。可以把两侧香蕉叶的根部移到中间两个垛口之间，让最外侧两道垛缝（3 格）露出来。
倒刺在待机时只是塔身两侧 1 格长的白点，读起来像铆钉。可以把待机时外沿倒刺改成 2 格（1 格骨白 + 1 格暗尖），斜向上 45°。
review.note: shoot=0、compare=0（最接近的是赌徒寡妇，0.662）。全库唯一的「会走的塔」体型，射孔里的眼光当脸用。藤臂卷香蕉，后甩、抡出后抛物线投掷。技能：敌弹打在塔上，倒刺逐根竖起，5 根绿刺弹飞出钉在假人身上，很好读。死亡：裂纹、下坐，chunks 碎成一地，香蕉滚出。hit 在 0.45 s 香蕉命中时，fall 在 1.217 s 碎块落地时，都对。ownColors 3（在引擎上限内）。

suggestions: IDLE：下层塔只比上层每侧宽 1–2 格，「下宽上窄的阶梯塔」在剪影里不明显。可以把下层塔每侧再加宽 2 格，或者把走道角垛加高 1 格，让台阶轮廓至少错开 3 格。
IDLE 截图里中间那片香蕉叶的叶柄和雷云底部贴得很近，彩色图里像一顶蘑菇盖。可以把中叶缩短 1 格，或者雷云上移 1 格，让它明显悬空。
review.note: shoot=0、compare=0（最接近的是邪眼王，施放 IoU 0.601）。和玉藤堡垒的升级关系清楚：雉堞塔、藤臂和香蕉都保留，加了雷云、3 只藤臂和带电蓝刺尖的荆棘，石色换成灰青。攻击是三只藤臂轮流连投：swing/shoot 在 f2/f4/f6，hit 在 0.383/0.55/0.717 s，对上三连击。技能：荆棘全亮、8 根刺弹，加三道 fx.bolt 连劈、假人眩晕，是这组里技能最强的。死亡是上层塔向后倒下（fall 0.9 s），再碎成 chunks，雷云散成雨丝。

plans.basis: 「能造成溅射伤害，其真正的力量隐藏于升级之后的形态」；特性 飞叶快刀「每次攻击，对目标附近小范围的敌人造成100%攻击力的技能伤害」（刀锋）；法师（技能攻击、很脆弱）；普通；近战 240；升级线 野法师→炮灰法师→法师英雄（同一株球茎植物从发芽到盛放）
plans.body: 人形（parts.rig child + 自画球茎头）
plans.build: 孩童体，约 22 格：头身比 3，头是 8 格宽的大圆洋葱球茎（顶部收尖），四肢细短，站姿略内八，像一株刚发芽的小洋葱。本组唯一的孩童体；和 nun 的娇小体型拉开：没有头巾，头本身就是球茎
silhouette: 头顶两片嫩叶芽向左右分叉，高出球茎 4 格（全线共有：芽→叶冠→花冠）
右手细枝短杖，杖头一片锯齿大叶刃伸出身前 5 格
肩上一圈下垂的叶片小披肩，叶尖锯齿外翘（全线共有的叶披）
球茎头底部垂下两条细根须到下巴（内部）

plans.gait: 蹦跳：两脚并拢一次蹦一格，落地时球茎头压扁 1 格，很轻，不扬尘
plans.deathStyle: 枯萎：头顶嫩芽先蔫垂下来，身体像枯苗一样从腰部折弯、侧着倒下，叶片卷曲变枯褐，自上而下消散，绿色魂光上升
plans.mainColors: 主材质是嫩黄绿叶片（披肩、叶芽），用 green 偏黄 [勾线 #13240c, 暗 #2f5a1a, 基 #5f9a2c, 亮 #a6d45a]；球茎头是奶白洋葱皮 [#3a3020, #8c7d62, #d8ccae, #f4efe0]，带淡紫纵纹；枝杖用 wood

苔泥色皮肤，会往下滴泥（内部）

chars.summary: The first form: a child-sized onion sprout. It has an 8-cell cream bulb head with faint purple streaks, two leaf sprouts on top that the idle spins like a propeller, and a serrated leaf cape. Its thin twig staff ends in a serrated leaf blade whose vein glows. Attack: steps in and swings the staff sideways, and 3 spinning leaves circle the target and its neighbours (splash). Skill: fallen leaves spiral up around the head, it spins in place (2 mirrored frames) and throws 8 leaves in a fan, which land as 3 crossing slashes plus a splash ring of radius 10. Moves by hopping, and the bulb squashes 1 cell on landing. Dies by withering: the sprouts droop, it folds at the waist, falls sideways and turns brown. Built from the parts library (rig child, legs, torso, arm, mantle). Audit passes, no duplicate found, the 4 gait frames are all different.

The second form, same plant grown fat: head and body are one purplish-red onion, 18 cells wide. It has a 4-leaf crown on top, a dried gourd cannon slung across its back (muzzle over the shoulder), a vine strap, a bulging crystal pouch at the waist, and 3 cracks that glow pink-purple. Attack: bends forward to point the gourd ahead and lobs a hard seed on a high arc. Skill (early harvest): the cracks light up one by one and the bulb swells, then the top crack pops open and sprays 10 crystals that bounce twice and turn into gold '+' marks. Waddles when it walks; the idle bounces the pouch. Dies by splitting in two: the halves land as two bowls showing the onion rings, and 6 crystals roll out. Body, gourd, crown and pouch are hand-drawn; legs and arms come from the parts library. Audit passes, no duplicate found.

The final form: tall build (rig tall) with a 7-cell onion head and a magenta flower crown (4 opening levels; the flower centre is the glow source). It has a long leaf cape ending in 3 leaf tips, a vine longbow taller than the body with curling tendrils at both tips, thorn arrows, root-coloured boots, and it keeps the leaf cape collar and a small crystal pouch from the earlier forms. Attack: draws the bow fully for 2 frames and fires a thorn arrow with leaf fletching. Skill (super bloom): sprouts spread along the ground at its feet, pollen gathers into the flower centre, then the crown opens fully and the body grows 2 cells taller, followed by 3 up-arrows, a leaf ring and a vine ring tightening at its feet. Dies by kneeling, then the death kit's ash mode dissolves it into petals from the top down. On the second pass, taller boots and a narrower cape flare made the leg change readable, and the petals were thinned out; the regression check shows nothing disappeared. Audit passes, no duplicate found.

built.feedback: 1) The parts.bow bend is fixed at 1.6 + pull*0.7 and cannot be changed. With len 15, a standing (idle) bow is nearly a straight pole and reads more like a staff, so a bend parameter would help. 2) With rimAll: 1 on a large sprite, the default rimR lights up the whole narrow top of the head in gold and cream; the radius had to be cut to [0,4,6,9] before it looked right. Worth adding a line to the README. 3) With the death kit, poseAt is called with a quantized time inside the death.start event, so P.dq = 1 must be set slightly after that event time. If dq takes effect exactly at that time, the frame being baked is already hidden and the ash has nothing to use. A README note would help. 4) frames.mjs --grid needs a Chinese state-name keyword (for example '施放:1'); the English CAST is not recognised. Otherwise nothing blocked the work.

chars.summary: Hunched moss-mud wild man with a deer-skull mask and branching antlers, a straw cloak, and a bone staff taller than himself with tooth bells and a glowing spore gourd on top. Attack: swings the staff forward and the gourd sprays a spore cloud onto the target. Skill (Mini Slime summon): a bone circle in front of him, spores spiral into the gourd, he slams the staff and a mud geyser erupts, then a spearman silhouette rises out of the mud from dark to bright. Death: melts into a mud puddle with the mask and staff on it, a small spearman outline swells in the mud, then everything dissolves. shoot exit 0, compare exit 0, gaitEvery2 first 4 frames all different.

Evolved form of the priest: fat build, the same deer-skull mask enlarged into a crown with palmate antlers (4 tines each side, gold vines, red feathers), a huge tiger-striped hide cloak dragging on the ground with a fur collar, big belly with white mud paint, and a bone-club sceptre topped with a small skull whose eye sockets glow. Attack: raises the sceptre overhead and smashes down. Skill (Slime Breeding): gold vines light up segment by segment, mud bubbles at his feet and his belly pulses, then a two-handed ground slam opens two cracks (one forward, one back); a mud mound bursts at each end and two spearman silhouettes pop out. Death: sits down, falls onto his back, the mask rolls off, two mud bubbles swell on his belly and pop, then he dissolves. shoot exit 0, compare exit 0, gaitEvery2 correct.

built.feedback: 1) The Sprite buffer needs at least 2-3 spare rows below y=0: the selective outline adds one row under the feet, and if it touches the buffer edge the audit reports "drawn to the buffer edge". The README doesn't mention this (I had set h = oy + 2 and it failed). 2) When blitShape is given a baked sprite's out, the silhouette includes the outline, so 1-cell gaps get filled and a small silhouette turns into a blob. For a single-colour silhouette it works better to take the shape from sprite.mat. The README could mention this. 3) fx.pillar can only break apart from the top down; there is no pillar that erupts upward from the ground, so I drew the mud geyser myself. 4) Workflow agents share the same scratchpad directory, and another agent overwrote a temporary script of mine with the same name, so temporary files need unique names.

chars.summary: 青龙：东方游龙，没有翅膀，细长 S 形蛇身悬浮离地约 4 格。身体是自画的 40 点脊线，逐像素画出腹鳞和鳞纹；头用 quad.head（dragon 头型，去掉默认角）。自画部件：后掠分叉鹿角、两条长龙须、背脊淡翠鬃鳍、尾尖鬃簇、4 条短爪腿、爪托青玉龙珠（5 档亮度）。攻击是昂头后张嘴吐一颗青玉吐息弹。技能「生命交换」：蓄力时盘紧身体，鳞片从尾到头一格格转灰，被抽出的光点汇进龙珠；施放时 fx.link 连向友军，再变粗成 fx.beam，自身闪红 1 帧并下沉 1 格；命中时友军身上升起十字治疗光点，加冲击环和 allyFx 描边；收招时灰鳞只恢复一半。死亡是坠落：龙珠熄灭脱手，身体盘着落地（离地 3→1→0），鳞片褪成灰绿，龙珠滚开后最后一闪熄灭，然后消散。音效声明为 hover、pal nature、style heal。shoot.mjs 退出码 0，专属色 12 个；compare 对已通过角色退出码 0；步态 gaitEvery2 前 4 帧各不相同。

天龙：青龙的进化版，用同一套脊线画法放大（62×35）。身体中段拱成大 C 形，驾一朵卷云（云团轮流鼓起）。新增白羽大翼（B.wing feather，6 根飞羽）、三叉鹿角、两角之间悬一圈旋转的淡金光环；鬃、须、尾鬃变成白色云鬃，前爪高举更大的天青龙珠。攻击是前爪推珠，射出一道 1 格宽的天青光束。技能「灵魂转移」：蓄力时羽翼全张，光环亮起并旋转，魂光螺旋汇进龙珠；施放时龙珠朝天一举，天降 fx.pillar 落在友军身上，自身一闪变淡；命中时友军脚下出现 fx.circle 法阵，羽毛光点往上飘，加 allyFx 描边；收招时羽翼收起，光环暗回 1 档。死亡是化云消散：光环熄灭、羽翼垂落，身体从尾到头一节节化成白云团；龙珠坠地，一闪后熄灭。音效声明为 hover、pal holy、style beam。shoot.mjs 退出码 0；compare 对已通过角色、以及和青龙两两比较都通过；修改后 compare --prev 退出码 0。

built.feedback: 1）B.mats 和 E.defMat 只认色板下标，不认 hex。直接写 hex 字符串数组不会报错，画出来却是一片黑；audit 也拦不住（色板检查通过）。必须包一层 E.ramp([...])。建议 B.mats 或 defMat 遇到字符串数组时自动调用 ramp()，或者在 README 里写明。2）parts-beast 没有东方龙那种细长蛇身的骨架：quad 是胸、臀两个圆，serpent 是贴地的蛇。这次自己写了脊线加逐像素栅格化的蛇身，可以考虑收进库里，做成 B.coil 之类的骨架。3）要让 quad.head 单独接在自画身体上，得自己拼一个伪 rig（head/eye/mouth），能用，但文档里没说。4）frames.mjs 里 MOVE 的 sequence 每一帧编号都不同（可能把位移也算进去了），不太好判断步态有没有重复帧，只能看 gaitEvery2。

chars.summary: 充能塔（稀有固定塔，idle 25×34，专属色 8）：中空老树干塔身，6 圈年轮发光刻线，两扇小窗像一双眼，右侧铜边投币口和小铜铃，底部盘根张开 20 格，塔顶四根爪枝托着六角琥珀晶。攻击：晶体一闪，打出一道折线琥珀电弧（fx.bolt），下一帧再补一道余电。技能「美味·存钱罐塔」：金币被定点吸进投币口，刻线像进度条一样从下往上亮满，铜铃摇响；施放时晶体「叮」地变白，塔顶喷出 12 枚翻转的琥珀币，币落地弹跳，每枚溅起金色「+」，再加一圈冲击环、地面映光和 1 格震屏；收招时刻线从上往下依次暗掉。移动是根须挪移：盘根错位、抬起，塔身前倾后仰，4 个步态帧各不相同。死亡是倾倒：先横向裂开，上半截斜切后倒，再转 90° 躺倒，落下两帧，扬尘并散出 7 枚铜币；晶体滚开、闪几下熄灭，最后消散。SFX 为 stone/topple/coin/coin/0.6，step、swing、hit、impact、fall 都在关键帧上。shoot 退出码 0；compare（reference + accepted）退出码 0，和玉藤堡垒、风暴堡垒的 idleIoU 分别为 0.60、0.41。

火神塔（传说，充能塔最终形态，idle 35×38，专属色 12）：下宽上窄的火山岩石堡，砌缝和两道熔岩裂缝从下往上发光，石缝里露出老树干；保留充能塔的盘根和投币口。两侧是 L 形烟囱耳，口上有火苗。圆鼓炮塔正面是火神面具：金色怒眉、炽眼、獠牙口，额心嵌着充能塔那颗琥珀晶，两颊火焰胡须伸出 3 格。面具下两根喇叭口铜炮管前伸 8 格，会随温度从铜色烧红到白热。攻击：双管交替后坐，连射两发熔金弹（自定义 drawShot），配炮口光。技能「美味·熔炉铸币」：炮口抬成 1:2 斜向上，熔光一路流到炮塔，炮管烧红，投币口吸入金光；施放时双炮朝天斜轰两团熔金，面具张口吐火光，烟囱耳喷火，配 2 格震屏和天空闪白；熔金在假人上空炸开，化成 16 颗带火尾的金币流星，落地溅起火星和金色「+」，假人被点燃染色并大摇。移动是石座跳挪：下沉、跳起 3 格、落地扬尘并震屏 1 格、站稳。死亡是爆炸：炮管过热发白，全身岩缝亮起并颤抖，然后用 death.start('burst') 炸开，10 枚熔金币四散，碎石落成一堆。SFX 为 machine/explode/fire/meteor/0.95。shoot 退出码 0；compare 退出码 0，和充能塔、玉藤堡垒、风暴堡垒的 idleIoU 分别为 0.65、0.55、0.54。

built.feedback: 没有卡住的地方。以下三点可以改进：(1) 固定塔 / 建筑类单位没有现成骨架，也没有通用的「落笔变换」（原位、斜切倾倒、转 90° 躺倒），我在 ChargeTower 里自己写了 S() 变换来画上半截倒下的过程。这可以收进 parts-beast 做成通用的「建筑倾倒」工具。(2) README 里 SFX 的 body 词表没有 wood，木质塔只能用 stone 代替。(3) FireGodTower 的火苗每帧都在闪，导致 MOVE 的 12fps 帧几乎全都不同（gaitEvery2 仍然正确）。这不影响验收，但 frames.mjs 的帧序会失去「同帧同号」的可读性。

chars.summary: 影剑士：瘦高档（slim，约 29×33 格）。白木狐面具，两只尖耳高出头顶 3 格，青光眼缝，朱红眉线；破长围巾向后飘约 11 格，尾端碎成锯齿；右手反握墨绿弯刀，刀身贴在前臂下、刀尖伸出肘后；腰间空刀鞘斜翘到身后。攻击是闪步贴近后反手自下而上横扫，原地留残影。技能「暗影繁殖者」：收刀低伏，身后影子拉长、影中睁开青光 → 拔刀贴地反手横斩影子 → 影子从地面立起成墨青剪影分身并睁眼 → 收刀，分身淡出。步态为闪步，每两步瞬移 2 格并留 1 帧残影。待机个性是拔刀式。死亡方式为被斩开：刀断两截落地，身体沿斜线错开、上半截下滑 2 格，之后化成墨绿烟。元素为自建色阶 forestShade（白→淡青→墨青→深紫→墨）。音效 SFX 为 shadow/shadow，重量 0.3。审核 audit 无问题，查重 compare 与 compare --prev 退出码均为 0，移动帧序 gaitEvery2 前 4 帧各不相同。

影骑士：英武档（heroic，约 35×38 格），是影剑士的进化形态。白金狐首全盔，狐吻前伸，一对尖耳向后掠、高出盔顶 5 格，眼缝紫白；墨紫夜甲配长甲裙；破披风拖地后再往后拖 6 格，末端碎成锯齿；肩上蹲一只小狐影；双手裂织巨剑，剑身中列是空心紫白裂隙，发光分 5 档。攻击是举剑过顶后竖劈。技能「憎恨繁殖者」：巨剑高举，紫白折线裂纹向剑刃汇聚 → 竖劈落下，身前留一道 26 格高的裂缝 → 裂缝撕开成菱形空洞，1:1 的影骑士剪影从裂隙中踏出 → 裂缝从两端合拢。步态为滑行，步子小、身体不起伏，脚下影子向前铺开。待机为拄剑，小狐影回头甩尾。死亡：跪地拄剑 → 身上出现两档紫白裂纹 → 用死亡套件 chunks 碎成块；插在地上的剑由 fxMid 继续画，裂隙一闪后熄灭。元素为 riftweave（白→#e4dbff→43→42→52）。音效 SFX 为 arcane/summon，重量 0.85。审核 audit 无问题，查重 compare 退出码 0。

built.feedback: 1) 死亡套件启动后（DK.on），引擎不再绘制 hero 精灵。「碎裂后武器仍插在地上」这类需求只能在 fxMid 里手动把 hero.out 逐像素 put 出来，README 没有写明这一点。建议补一句说明，或给死亡套件加一个 keep 选项。2) near() 选色时可能落到夜空色：例如 '#1c1230' 被映射成下标 1（#12132e），整件盔甲因此变成夜空色。建议 near 排除 1–4 号夜空色。3) 默认 parts.hair 画在无盔帽的面具头之后，会在面具上压出一圈分界线，改成画在 head 之前（用 long 款）才干净。README 的「头小的时候」一节可以补上「面具 / 全覆盖头」的情况。

chars.summary: 影骑士分身：heroic 缩小的墨紫单色剪影，腰以下没在自画的影池里（没有腿，靠影池滑行，4 帧步态）。狐首盔两只尖耳，14 格双手巨剑斜举，剑刃一道白边；轮廓边缘隔几行缺一格，每 0.4 s 错位 1 格。攻击：举剑过顶，连人带剑往下砸（身体沉进池 2 格）。技能「影压」：影池扩到 24 格，身体升起露出影子腿 → 砸进地面，只剩剑倒插在池里 → 目标脚下冒出影池，同时有裂纹、暗色影浪，目标下陷 1 格 → 身体扶剑浮出来。死亡：坍缩，被吸回影池，影池收成一个点「噗」地消失，3 颗紫白碎光上升。共自检 2 轮：shoot 0、compare 0（最接近的是驱魔修女，待机 IoU 0.595）、--prev 0、gaitEvery2 前 4 帧各不相同。

影剑士分身：slim 上半身的墨青剪影，膝盖以下化成向后拖 8 格、末端分叉的烟尾，离地 2 格漂浮（hover）。灰白狐面具上有两道青眼缝，头上是狐耳；反握弯刀，刀身横着伸向身后，刃边一线青光；背后一条短飘带。待机时模仿本体的拔刀式，慢半拍，中途卡顿错位 1 帧。攻击：闪到目标前反手下刺。技能「影袭」：身体逐行沉进地面影子，只剩面具浮在影上 → 影子贴地滑到目标背后（地面暗带、拖尾，原地留 1 帧残影）→ 跃出反手下刺（十字星芒、墨青烟外爆）→ 沉回影子滑回原位。死亡：噗散，身体炸成一团墨青烟，面具掉下弹一下后化灰。共自检 2 轮：shoot 0、compare 0（最接近的是星辉巫师，待机 IoU 0.453）、--prev 0、gaitEvery2 前 4 帧各不相同。

built.feedback: 1）parts.px 的「不画进地面以下」判断在 begin 的 dY 偏移之前，begin 的 clipY 也是偏移前的本地坐标。要做「身体沉进地面」，只能改 rig 的 leg 值（可以为负），README 里没写这种用法，建议补一句。2）keyer 会按取整后的值编码：角度要先换算成 ASTEP 的整数档，dq 要先乘 48，否则越界。E.keyer 的注释里没提这一点，parts.keyer 那边有第 4 个参数「倍数」，两边不一致。3）frames.mjs 的 MOVE 序列在移动时每帧都算作不同帧（看起来像把 mx 也算了进去），不影响 gaitEvery2 的判断，但 distinct 数字会误导人。4）shoot 截图里单色暗剪影在夜空背景上对比度很低，这是分配要求的配色，所以靠轮廓光和发光边来辨认。

chars.summary: 野人矛兵：big-head short build (parts.rig child override leg5/torso6/head8, sw4, limb1.3), half-crouched. Parts: white boar-skull mask with outward tusks (it can turn to face backward), a two-handed flint-tipped spear longer than the body with a grass tuft on the butt, two spare short spears fanned out on the back, moss-mud skin, grass skirt. Idle: looks back, then scratches the back of the mask. Move: hunched trot, 1 dust puff per step. Attack: two jabs in a row (grip slides back on the shaft so the spear drives forward) with speed lines. Skill 猛投 (big throw): leans back with the spear over the shoulder, flint tip flashes, rings of dust at the feet → throw on a shallow arc (custom 1×7 spear projectile) → spear sticks in the target, earth burst, ground crack, impact ring, knockback → pulls a short spear from the back. Death: falls forward, a mud bubble swells on the back and pops out a moss-green mini slime that hops twice, then everything dissolves together. Element earth, SFX flesh/topple/earth/blade. shoot.mjs exit 0; compare.mjs exit 0 (closest 驱魔修女, idle IoU 0.631); --prev exit 0; gaitEvery2 first 4 frames all distinct.

巨蟹钳：B.bug crab body (3 thin legs per side, small round shell, legs tucked under the shell) plus one hand-drawn giant coral-red claw taking about 70% of the body, held upright in front as a shield. The claw has 3 orientations: forward / up / down. It has a palm, a fixed finger, a movable finger that opens around its hinge, inner teeth, bone-white hooked tips, barnacles, and hanging seaweed. Two long thin eye stalks. Idle: claw clacks open and shut twice, eye stalks turn. Move: claw plants on the ground like a crutch and drags the body forward. Attack: claw turns horizontal, opens and snaps shut on the target, with bite arcs. Skill 钳盾 (claw shield): claw raised and opened as a shield, fx.dome water shield, water droplets converge on the claw tip → shield pushes forward and breaks into splashes, claw slams shut → two claw arcs pinch at the target, gravity splashes, impact ring, stun. Death: flips belly-up with the claw pointing at the sky, legs kick in the air then freeze, claw slowly closes, dissolve. Element water, SFX armor/topple/water/shield. shoot.mjs exit 0; compare.mjs exit 0 (closest 赌徒寡妇, idle IoU 0.508); --prev exit 0; gaitEvery2 distinct.

built.feedback: 1) B.mats（parts-beast）不像 parts.mats 那样把 #hex 转成色板下标：hex 字符串原样交给 defMat，结果整只角色渲染成黑色，而 shoot.mjs 仍然退出码 0，自动验收没拦住（色板检查也没报）。建议 B.mats 内部走 E.ramp，或者 audit 检查材质下标是不是数字。2) 投掷类技能要浅抛物线，shoot() 只有直线运动，只能在 fxFront 里自己计时画；可以考虑给 shoot 加一个重力选项。3) 查看页的 frames.mjs 在移动状态把每一帧都算成不同帧（sequence 0..19），因为带了 mx 位移，看步态重复不太直观。4) 工作流的 scratchpad 目录是多个代理共用的：我放在里面的临时脚本 crop.py 被别的代理覆盖了，建议每个代理用自己的子目录。

chars.summary: 小螃蟹（自然·先锋·普通衍生单位）：正面、左右对称的扁平沙黄小蟹（专属 4 色沙壳 + 奶白壳底 + 墨褐螺旋斑 + 橘红螯尖 + 2×2 黑豆眼柄），每侧 4 条放射尖腿，两只对称小螯高出壳 3 格。待机吐 3 个水泡并轮流举螯；移动是横窜急停（每 4 帧窜 3 停 1，两组腿交替，每个步态帧扬 1 颗沙，接触帧 step）；攻击压低后横冲 11 格用壳沿撞（速度线 + impact + 小泡溅出，swing smash / hit stone）；技能「缩壳翻滚」：螯腿缩进、壳贴地越转越快（螺旋斑和暗斑逐帧换位）+ 白泡环绕 → 施放时变成壳球横滚 16 格（4 个朝向），拖泡沫尾和沙尘，0.25 s 撞上目标：fx.circle 泡点阵 + 水花外爆 + 大冲击环 + 大摇 + 震屏 1，泡泡外飞后破成水花；收招翻身落地螯腿啪地伸出，再横窜回位；死亡钻沙：掀翻 → 四脚朝天落地（fall）→ 翻回猛刨沙陷进地面 → 只剩眼柄眨一下 → 留下沙堆消散 + 魂光。SFX body beast · collapse · water · shield · 0.2。shoot 验收通过（退出码 0），compare 退出码 0（idleIoU 0.31、castIoU 0.03、配色 0.08），compare --prev 退出码 0，MOVE gaitEvery2 前 4 个编号各不相同。身体没用 bug 骨架（它是侧视），正面蟹的部件写在模块里并标了候选部件。

suggestions: SKILL 蓄力：落叶被吸起、螺旋汇聚后绕球茎头环绕这一段很稀，4_skill_charge 里只有零星几颗粒子。把 K_SPIRAL 粒子加到 20 颗以上，最后 0.3 s 转成绕头的 K_ORBIT 环。
SKILL 施放：旋转只有 侧 → 正（镜像）→ 侧镜像 → 侧 这几个朝向，没有背面帧。补 1 帧背面（后脑球茎，看不到脸），凑满 standard §7 要求的 4 个朝向。
SKILL 命中：溅射圈（半径 10 格的叶片外爆）读不太出来。在假人位置加一个 nature 色阶的 ring()，再从目标中心向外 burst 12–16 颗叶片。
攻击出手帧只有 1 帧的叶片弧光。可以延续到 2 帧（第 2 帧 1 格宽、断续，取第 3 级色）。
review.note: shoot=0，compare=0（最接近的是巫毒信徒：idle IoU 0.566、cast 0.419）。孩童体配大球茎头，头顶双叶芽加锯齿叶刃杖，剪影好认，和同组角色拉得开。待机时叶芽会转，移动是蹦跳步态，死亡是枯萎后倒地变褐色、叶杖滑脱，都符合设定卡。sfx：step 落在蹦跳着地帧，swing 在 f2，hit 在 f3，fall 在 f11 倒地帧，对得上。已复制到 accepted/WildMage。

suggestions: DEATH：第 11 帧还站着带裂缝，第 12 帧直接变成地上的两瓣，中间没有过渡。在 0.5–0.66 s 之间补 2 帧：两瓣从头顶裂开、各向左右外倒 45°，离地 3 → 1 格，第 12 帧再落地。
DEATH：掉在地上的葫芦炮向左弹出约 39 格，查看页里被舞台左边缘切掉了（8_death_down.png）。把弹出距离收到 20 格以内，或者改成向后上方弹、落在身后 10–15 格。

The --prev regression check exit code is 0. I verified all 6 blocking items from round 1. (1) The eyestalks are short black dots that sit about 2 pixels above the claw tip. (2) The claw is held at a slant of about 30-40° with a clear V-shaped gap and serrated inner edges, and the barnacles are visible on its back. (3) The legs are short and do not rise above the shell. (4) In idle the claw's front edge does not reach the dummy; it only lunges into it on the attack frames. (5) The charge shows a dotted water-blue half-circle shield. The cast pushes it forward, the claw snaps shut, and the hit shows the pincer arcs, a water burst and stun stars. (6) Death uses a separate flipped pose: shell belly up, claw pointing at the sky, legs kicking in the air, then the claw slowly closes and the body dissolves. The sound timeline lines up with the animation: steps fall on the claw-planting frames every 4 frames, swing and hit on attack frame 2 where the claw thrusts, and fall on death frame 11 where it lands flipped. chars.summary: Short, stocky white bear (35×29, head held below the shoulder line) built on quad. Custom parts: a three-leaf sapling on the shoulder hump, a jagged fur fringe along belly and neck, a flat-topped notched left ear, and a purple void scar on the nose bridge. Attack is a lowered-head shoulder charge that moves 7 tiles forward. Skill 繁茂: crouches while green motes spiral into the sapling, which grows 3 px and goes from 3 to 5 leaves; on cast the body swells 1 px and the 5 glowing leaves orbit the body; in recovery the leaves yellow one at a time and fall. Idle quirk is a head-to-tail fur shake. Death: topples onto its side and the sapling snaps off and bounces away. Nature element; SFX beast/topple/nature/buff/0.75. Highest similarity to other characters: idle IoU 0.604, cast IoU 0.713.

Huge black-brown bear with a tall shoulder hump and a wedge shape (40×35), neck ruff, a bone-white crescent on the chest, and a charred twisted branch holding a red-glowing forbidden fruit. Molten back cracks light up with mana; the notched left ear and nose scar are kept. Attack: rears up with both paws raised, then slams down; the raised forelegs are drawn after the head so they stay visible. Skill 禁果: while rearing, sparks spiral into the fruit, the fruit grows through 3 sizes and the cracks light one by one, and a fire link line connects to the dummy. On cast the slam and fruit explosion fire a nova with 36 particles and ground cracks, then fire runs along the link and bursts on the dummy (dummy tinted fire). Death: swells, glows white, then bursts into molten chunks using death.start('burst'). Fire element; SFX beast/explode/fire/nova/0.9. Highest similarity: idle IoU 0.697, cast IoU 0.618.

Long, flat bear with birch-bark skin (pale ramp with dark horizontal marks) and stumpy trunk-like legs (39×38). Custom parts: a full round canopy on its back (trunk and branches, dark back layer, bright front leaf clumps, 5 glowing pale-gold fruits), root-flare feet, vines hanging from chin and neck, and a sprout growing out of the nose scar; the notched left ear is kept. Attack: stomps one forefoot, a ground crack runs forward, and two roots rise under the dummy, sweep across it, then retract. Skill 奉献 (allies appear during the skill): fruits light one by one, a green-sprout ground wave spreads backwards, and holy/nature motes spiral into the canopy. On cast, petals are thrown back and up and vine links run to each ally; hits land on the allies as rising holy crosses, a small ring and an outline glow. Death: the canopy yellows and sheds, the body kneels stiff like a dead log, then splits into wood chunks using death.start('chunks') and turns to ash. Holy element with nature leaves; SFX beast/collapse/holy/heal/0.85. Highest similarity: idle IoU 0.525, cast IoU 0.507.

built.feedback: 1) The parts library has no way to raise the forelegs for a rearing pose. Pitch 6 only lifts the chest; the forelegs hang straight down, and a paw only raises the near leg by 2 px. I rewrote rig.legs[i].F inside the module to get raised paws. Because Q.draw draws the legs before the mane and head, the raised paws end up hidden under the ruff and head, so I had to call Q.leg myself and change the draw order. Suggestion: add P.raise to quad, and have Q.draw automatically move raised forelegs after the head. 2) Q.anim.death only offers a topple onto the side (lie 2). There is no kneel/crumple final pose that holds lie 1; LifeTree's stiff kneel needs its own overrides after d≥0.3. 3) The four-legged characters in this batch have no shared helpers for the notched ear, nose-bridge scar or back plant used across the upgrade line, so each of the three modules repeats farEar and scar. 4) In the standard.md checklist, the rule that 'gaitEvery2's first 4 numbers must all differ' passes trivially whenever mx changes (every frame is unique). It cannot catch cases where the gait frames themselves repeat, so leg swaps have to be checked by eye in the silhouette row.

chars.summary: 黑剑：蓝黑瘦长低伏狼（quad，len13/腿细/深收腹/低颈），额头前指黑剑独角（伸出吻尖3格，刃口紫）、细尾末端上翘剑刃带护手、背脊锯齿黑鬃；待机低头嗅地（前后嗅、耳抽、甩尾）；贴地小跑每接触帧1颗尘；攻击低伏→前扑6格扑咬+剑角上挑弧；技能「狼群」：蓄力时身后两道curse第4级单色狼影由抖动点阵逐渐成形（copySprite+blitShape），施放本体前扑咬住、两道狼影跃过背上依次扑咬（带残影），目标身上3道紫裂痕（fx.crack）逐口小摇，第三口叠满出碎盾冲击环+诅咒染色大摇，收招狼影化紫尘、本体小弧跳回；死亡前扑滑出2格、剑角断裂飞出落地、自上而下消散+魂光。SFX beast/topple/curse/shadow/0.35。shoot 退出码0（audit 无问题，0专属色），compare 退出码0（与accepted、参考最大idleIoU 0.305），MOVE gaitEvery2 前4各不同、剪影换腿可见。HX 66。

暗牙：金毛健壮头狼（quad，比黑剑高、胸厚、昂头），浅金蓬松颈圈毛、下颌两支下垂黑剑牙（伸出下巴3格）、额头后弯黑弧刃+角根金环、加宽剑刃尾+金护手、身上4道紫诅咒纹（待机暗/蓄力逐条亮/施放全亮/收招暗回1档）；待机坐姿舔爪+刃尾拍地两次扬尘；昂首阔步（stride4）；攻击仰头短嚎发)形紫声波弹道（金色两端）；技能：蓄力脚下符文圈+地面符文点逆时针螺旋吸入口中、颈毛竖起（第二套shape maneLen4.5），施放长嚎3圈同心紫弧金边声波+震屏闪白，命中目标头顶旋转诅咒印记+身上12个紫点刻痕依次亮起（12层）+染色大摇；死亡仰天长嚎→侧倒伸腿→金毛从头到尾逐列褪灰白（mat重映射）→death.start('ash')化灰+魂光。SFX beast/dissolve/curse/nova/0.5。shoot 退出码0，compare 退出码0（含与黑剑互查 idleIoU 0.634、color 0.018）。待机外框44×29（弧刃高出头6格，比设定的22高）。HX 58（range 272 站得比黑剑远）。

built.feedback: 1) parts-beast 的 quad.tail 不返回尾梢位置和切线方向，想在尾尖挂东西（剑刃、尾锤、火焰）只能把尾巴走法整段抄进模块；建议 quad.tail 返回 {tip, a}。2) 头小（canine 6×5）时额头上的独立部件会把整个头压成勾线色，parts-beast.md 第四节只讲了马具，没提「角 / 额饰并进头部件」这个办法，第一轮黑剑的头几乎全黑。3) 没有「按区域换材质」的积木（死亡褪色、石化从脚往上），只能在 drawHero 末尾直接改 hero.mat，README 里没写这样做是否允许。4) shadow 色阶的亮部也很暗，四足全身用它时几乎只剩勾线，要另给吻部 / 腹线提亮才读得出头。

chars.summary: 地主（虚空·商人·优质）：矮胖 fat 体型 25×27，瓜皮帽 + 3 格发光虚空帽珠、胸前横端 11×6 算盘（伸出 6 格）、垂到膝下的鼓钱袋（方孔钱印记）、深紫马褂金边 + 苍灰蓝长袍、八字胡双下巴。攻击＝甩腕投打转铜钱；技能＝飞快拨算盘珠逐颗亮金、地面金币螺旋汇入钱袋并鼓大 2 格 → 钱袋一抖金币喷泉 + 金色冲击环 → 金币落地弹两下再吸回袋里 + 身后两道金色速度线（卖空）。死亡＝后仰倒地、钱袋破开铜钱撒一地、瓜皮帽翻滚滚落、帽珠熄灭。无新增颜色；shoot 通过、compare 退出码 0（最高待机 IoU 0.45）、gaitEvery2 前 4 帧各不相同。产出：pcd/chars/Landlord.js、pcd/batch-11/Landlord/design.md、pcd/batch-11/Landlord/shots。

金手（虚空·商人·史诗，地主的升级）：高胖 fat 体型 32×35，身体右倾；右臂换成鎏金机关巨手（4 种手形：半握、握拳、掌心向上、弹指，伸出身体 10 格）、背后高出头顶的金算盘框、紫缎瓜皮帽加金珠座和 3×3 帽珠、帽后金飘带、腕下金链宝匣、酒红锦袍暗金团花；保留地主的帽、八字胡、双下巴和算盘。攻击＝弹指射出 260 格/秒的金币；技能＝握拳吸金、指缝漏光 → 张手抛出 5 格巨币旋转砸地（冲击环 + 地裂 + 震屏 2 格）→ 碎成 24 枚小金币，一半暗色弹飞熄灭（亏损）、一半飞回金手（盈利）+ 卖空速度线。死亡＝金手先砸地、前扑，金手从指尖起逐段褪成铅灰后碎成几块，帽子滚开，算盘摔落在身后。自建特效色阶 lead 只用共享钢色，无新增颜色；shoot 通过、compare 退出码 0（最高待机 IoU 0.68）。产出：pcd/chars/GoldenHand.js、pcd/batch-11/GoldenHand/design.md、pcd/batch-11/GoldenHand/shots。

built.feedback: 1) 部件库里的 hwFrame / freeFrame 没有导出，想画会翻滚落地的帽子，只能在模块里自己建 { r0, tx, ty, rot, ox, oy } 这样的落笔框对象。建议把 freeFrame 导出成 parts.freeFrame(r0, x, y)。2) 前扑倒地时，想把前手放到精灵坐标里的某一点，得在模块里手写 rig 旋转的逆变换。建议加一个 parts.fromSprite(R, x, y)，和已有的 parts.toSprite 对应。3) K_PHYS 粒子落地后只会贴着地面，不会反弹。这次金币「弹两下」是自己算出落点和落地时刻，再依次生成新的粒子接上。可以考虑给 spawnX 加一个 o.bounce 参数。4) 同一个工作流里的多个代理共用同一个 scratchpad 目录：我放在里面的 crop.py 被别的代理覆盖了，后来改放到自己的子目录才解决。5) frames.mjs 里移动的 distinct 是 20/20（把位移 mx 也算了进去），第一眼容易误读成步态帧没有两两重复；实际像素逐帧对比是相同的。

chars.summary: Viking Pirate is a thin, slightly hunched old sailor (26×28 cells). He wears a faded navy frock coat and a tattered tricorn with an eye patch, and has a gray-white mustache. A small chest is chained to his back, its lid 4 cells above his shoulder. His left hand is a J-shaped iron hook that sticks out ahead of the body; his right hand holds a saber. Attack (thrust): the hook hooks the target and pulls it in, then the saber stabs forward. Skill 'Secret Hoard': he bends over, the hook pries the chest open, the chains come loose one by one and gold light leaks from the crack. The lid then pops open and a gold-purple pillar shoots to the top of the screen with coins spraying up. Nine coins fall back into the chest mouth, which flashes on each coin. He slams the lid and the chains lock. Death: kneels, then falls face-down; the chest breaks open behind him and coins roll out; the hat drifts to the ground. shoot exit 0, compare exit 0, gaitEvery2 frames all distinct, legs visibly swap on move contact frames. New candidate parts: chest, hook.

Shadow Grim Reaper is a tall, thin floating figure (28×37 cells) with no legs, hovering 2 cells off the ground. It wears a black tattered cloak with the navy lining kept from the pirate. Below the waist, smoke trails backward into two wisps. It wears the pirate's tricorn, now with a jagged brim, tilted over its hood. Under the pushed-up eye patch is one glowing purple eye, plus a jawbone. The pirate's hook has grown into a huge scythe whose blade curves over its head, with a ghost flame on the shaft. Idle: turns the scythe half a turn and back. Move: glides forward, leaning in. Attack (chop): leaves an afterimage, teleports 12 cells to the target and brings the scythe down overhead. Skill 'Unyielding Soul': turns into a dithered shadow silhouette and three enemy bullets pass straight through it. The body then reappears to one side with a white flash while the pierced afterimage shatters into soul light that spirals back in. Rim light goes to level 3, the shaft lights a second ghost flame, and it throws a cross slash at the dummy. Death: the cloak collapses into a heap under the hat, the scythe sticks in the ground, the eye goes out and the heap dissolves into smoke. shoot exit 0, compare exit 0. compare --prev exit 3 in round 2 only because the scythe was deliberately moved 3 cells forward and holes were added to the smoke. New candidate parts: scythe, smokeHem, clothHeap.

built.feedback: 1) The ink ramp is [0,0,0,0], so it gets no light/dark shading and a large ink area loses all shading. The Reaper's black cloak had to use [0,52,8,9] instead. Consider adding a shaded near-black ramp to the shared palette. 2) parts.hat with o.at still reads the rig's hw/hh inside hwBox, so a dropped hat called with a null rig crashes. You have to pass a stub like { hw: 6, hh: 6 }. 3) parts.head has no option for the eye-patch strap, so the patch has to be hand-drawn into the face. 4) parts.legs has no bowleg parameter, so the Pirate's bowed legs could not be drawn and are suggested only by the rolling sailor walk.

chars.summary: CrabWarlock (蟹术士) is done: a flat hermit crab built on the bug skeleton, in coral pink. It carries a sand spiral shell with purple runes (tip points back and up), wears a tilted purple hat between its eye stalks, and holds a coral staff with a bubble orb in its right claw. Attack: raises the staff and fires 3 hollow bubbles in a row. Skill: a water circle appears in front and bubbles gather into it. On cast, a water column rises from the circle and an orange crabling (echoing Crabling) pops out of a big bubble, lands with a splash ring, raises its claws twice, then walks sideways to the dummy and waits. Idle quirk: shuffles two steps sideways and back, blinking one eye stalk after the other. Death: flips belly-up, the hat flies off, the body pulls into the shell and only the empty shell is left before it dissolves. SFX: beast/collapse/water/summon, weight 0.3. shoot.mjs exit 0; compare.mjs exit 0 (closest is 蛮兵, idle IoU 0.58); --prev exit 0 after round 2. The design.md has both setting cards, the 依据 line and the 音色 line. Outputs: pcd/chars/CrabWarlock.js, pcd/batch-11/CrabWarlock/design.md, pcd/batch-11/CrabWarlock/shots/.

Crabomancer (蟹巫) is done: the evolved form, a long-legged hermit crab in deep orange-red with gold trim, 38×33 cells. It keeps CrabWarlock's three features, grown up: a tall spire shell with purple-lit windows, a tall hat with a string of shell bells, and a giant runed right claw held upright in front of the body. The claw is bigger than the body and can face right, up or down. A water orb circles above the left claw. Attack: the giant claw snaps shut across the gap, and in the same frame a water-shadow claw closes on the dummy. Skill: a water-vortex rift with a purple rim opens above the dummy and light from the orb is sucked into it. On cast, a giant claw (echoing Pincer) drops out of the rift and snaps shut on the dummy: big splash, ground crack, ring, heavy knockback and a 1-cell sink. During recover the claw rises in triumph, then fades, and the rift closes. Idle quirk: the claw opens and shuts while the bells ring. Walk: long-legged sideways stride with a big bob. Death: cracks spread from the claw, the window lights go out, then it shatters into chunks (death kit chunks) blasting out from the claw. SFX: armor/shatter/water/summon, weight 0.7. shoot.mjs exit 0; compare.mjs exit 0 (closest is 黄鬃马, IoU 0.57). compare.mjs --prev exited 3 on the last check; the only missing area is the water orb, which I moved on purpose. Outputs: pcd/chars/Crabomancer.js, pcd/batch-11/Crabomancer/design.md, pcd/batch-11/Crabomancer/shots/.

built.feedback: No blockers. Three things worth noting: (1) parts-beast B.mats always gives the `shell` material band 2. On the bug skeleton the near claw uses m.shell, so it came out dark all over. The fix was to leave `shell` out so the claw falls back to limb (band 1). (2) The bug skeleton's built-in eye stalks can't place a hat between them, so I drew my own stalks (stalks: 0). A spacing parameter for stalk position would help. (3) The engine does not export a plain blit for pre-baked summon sprites, so each module wrote its own blitOut with put(). A shared `blitSprite(s, X, Y, map?, dq?)` in the engine would save that duplication.

chars.summary: Pulsebot (脉冲机器人) is a squat, boxy walking mech, about 27×28 cells, built on a parts.rig stocky skeleton with its own mechanical parts. Silhouette: two upright antennas with lamps on the shoulders, a piston fist bigger than the head, a square battery backpack with an exhaust stack, and a purple pulse core in the chest. Main colour is granite grey (stone ramp one step lighter), with steel joints and gold/black warning stripes. Idle: the core pulses on the beat and the exhaust puffs steam at the end of the loop. Move: heavy mechanical steps with dust and steam. Attack: a hydraulic straight punch (rod extends 5 cells, speed lines) that sets off a steel shockwave ring at the fist, a ground crack and a purple debuff outline on the dummy. Skill (Granite Skin): 6 stone plates flip out and close one every 2 frames, stone chips spiral into the core, then the armour locks with a jolt, a steel dot-dome shield comes up, and three enemy shots hit the dome, whiten that segment and shatter into grey chips. Death: parts break off in stages, the helmet flies off and rolls, the knees hit the ground, the core flashes three times, a small blast, then death kit 'parts'. shoot exit 0, compare exit 0, MOVE gaitEvery2 frames all distinct; SFX declared with step/swing/hit/impact/fall hooked in.

Skybot (天空机器人) is Pulsebot's upgrade: a tall hovering mech, about 40×38 cells, 6 cells off the ground and leaning forward. It keeps Pulsebot's antennas (now longer electrodes with arcs), the piston fist (now with cooling fins and a flame nozzle on the back), the purple core, the helmet visor and the shoulder warning stripe. The backpack became a pair of up-swept steel wings with 4 nozzles, and the legs became two thrusters with flame tails. Main colour is polished steel-blue with crimson stripes. Idle: floats with flickering flames and an arc jumps between the antennas. Move: hover glide in which the thrusters swing front/back alternately (reads as swapping legs), wings flap and flames change length; ground shadow drawn. Attack: rises, then dives and rams with the fist, with a fire splash and a small cyan ring. Skill (Fire Divination + EMP): rises 4 cells, nozzles turn from blue to orange, arcs between the antennas get denser, the fist nozzle ignites, then a dive punch sets off a fire nova (big ring, shake, flash), followed by 3 cyan rings plus short bolts that lock the target (3 debuff stacks), a cyan outline and slowed wobble on the dummy, and fire keeps burning on the ground. Death: nozzles cut out, it mirror-spins as it falls, then explodes on impact (death kit 'burst' plus fire, smoke and a ring). shoot exit 0 (after fixing the cast having too few distinct frames and flames going below ground), compare exit 0; SFX hover:1 with pal bolt / style bolt.

chars.summary: Wooden-barrel cockpit hovering 8 cells up, brass hoops, 21-cell two-blade worn rotor, goblin with big pointed ears poking out of the barrel, twin short cannons in front, exhaust pipe at the back, coin bag hanging underneath. Attack: upper and lower cannons fire alternately (casings drop). Skill 美味: pilot rubs his hands while the bag swells and glows, then the bag opens and coins rain down, bounce twice, and each landing spot shows a gold cross star plus a gold ring on the ground; afterwards he ties the bag and shakes his head. Idle: bites a coin and looks around. Move: nose down, rotor blur, black smoke trail. Death: spirals down in black smoke, breaks into planks on impact (chunks) and coins spill out. Checks: shoot exit 0, compare exit 0, gaitEvery2 first 4 frames all different. compare --prev exit 3; the changes are the intended ear, barrel, cannon and engine rework.

The same barrel cockpit now clad in army-green plating, keeping one brass hoop on the rim. Adds a tail boom, vertical fin and tail rotor, and a wider 27-cell rotor with red tips. Only an empty gun mount is left under the nose. The goblin wears a leather cap with ear flaps and gold-framed goggles, ears poking through the flaps, and shoulders a rocket launcher longer than the body (red bands, 3 ammo lights, muzzle 6 cells past the nose). Attack: small rocket with a smoke trail. Skill 巨型爆能枪: ammo lights come on one by one, white smoke at the muzzle, heat spirals in and the machine tilts back; a giant rocket fires with recoil pushing the machine back 3 cells and flame out of the rear; hit is a fireball, big ring and rising smoke cloud, target knocked back. Idle: pats the tube, a smoke puff from the muzzle, goggle glint. Death: launcher blows first, then the machine explodes in midair (parts) and the rotor flies off on its own. Checks: shoot exit 0, compare exit 0, gaitEvery2 first 4 frames all different. compare --prev exit 3; the changes are the intended tail boom, fin and tail rotor rework.

built.feedback: parts-beast.md 把机械 / 旋翼机标成「未做」，所以没有骨架，旋翼、机身、尾梁都是模块里自己画的。驾驶员能用 parts.rig，但要把 rig 的 oy 手动改掉，才能把人放进座舱；README 没写这个办法，写一句会更好。另外悬浮 / 坠落的角色要自己算 begin 的 clipY（clipY = 离地增量），这点也没有写明。frames.mjs 的主输出图缩得太小，看不清细节，这次是用 PIL 裁剪截图来看的。

chars.summary: 曲速之翼：小型扁平虚空魔鬼鱼（约 32×22 格，离地 10 格）。3/4 俯视的扁菱形天青身体和白腹，上下两片宽三角鳍翼，翼缘有一道青色等离子线，分 5 段逐段亮或灭。头前一对前卷的紫色角状头鳍，11 格鞭尾末端一颗 5 档等离子球。攻击：尾鞭后引上翘，再往前一甩，甩出等离子弹。技能「等离子衰减」：蓄力时翼缘从根到尖逐段亮起、尾球变大，身下有旋转的点阵地面光环；施放时一圈扁椭圆光环向外扩散（前后半圈分层画）扫过假人，假人被染暗一级、摇晃变慢，身上冒出下沉粒子。死亡：翻滚坠落，翻成肚子朝上，鳍抽两下，翼缘一段段熄灭，化成星尘消散。已写 SFX 声明（nova，重量 0.3，hover），step/swing/shoot/hit/impact/fall 事件齐全。自检 3 轮：shoot 退出码 0，compare 退出码 0（最高 idleIoU 0.41），--prev 退出码 0，gaitEvery2 前 4 帧各不相同。

虚空魔鬼鱼：曲速之翼的进化版，巨型扁平飞行（约 45×32 格，离地 12 格），身体更厚。保留头鳍（改为 10 格长、向前抱拢的弯角）、长尾（尾端变三颗串珠）、翼缘等离子线（变两道）。背上大半是夜空星图，8 颗星点会旋转、轮流闪烁。主色：以 gem 的深紫 25 作勾线，另加 2 个品红紫专属色（gem 的基/亮是蓝青色，会和等离子青混在一起，design.md 已写明）。攻击：抬头后从腹下等离子口吐出扁的等离子盘，打中后弹开飞走。技能：蓄力时星图旋转，星尘定点汇聚到腹口，三颗尾珠依次亮起；施放时等离子盘在假人和地面之间弹 3 次并留下拖尾，每打中一次在假人身上压一圈紫环，3 圈叠在一起，下沉粒子更密，假人闪白大摇。死亡为内爆：腹下出现墨色虚空点，身体从翼缘开始按抖动碎掉，星尘螺旋着被吸进虚空点，虚空点缩小后一闪消失。SFX 声明：spiral，重量 0.7，dissolve，hover。自检 2 轮：shoot 退出码 0，compare 退出码 0（最高 idleIoU 0.49），--prev 退出码 0，gaitEvery2 前 4 帧各不相同。

built.feedback: 1) parts-beast.md 第十二节写着「VoidManta 可以在 B.wing 加 type 'fin'」，分配里也写了「B.wing 需加 type 'fin'」，但本轮部件库冻结，只能把鳍翼写在模块里。两份模块各有一份一样的 finWing 代码，以后收进库时要合并。2) 分配写「虚空品红紫（gem 色阶）」，但 gem 色阶的基/亮实际是蓝/青，不是品红，只能另加专属色，说明文字和色阶名对不上。3) B.fly 只适合鸟和蝙蝠的侧视，扁身体飞行生物没有可用的骨架，只能整只自己画。4) 飞行单位飞在 10–12 格高时正好落在背景远山的暗色带里，sky 色阶的暗级会和山影混在一起，近侧鳍要换亮一级的色阶才看得见，这点在说明里没有提示。5) frames.mjs 对 MOVE 报「distinct 20」，同一步态帧的两个 12fps 帧也被算成不同帧，可能是把 mx 位移算进去了，要看 gaitEvery2 才能判断步态对不对。

chars.summary: 歼灭者：高瘦的反关节机甲，一台会走的弩。两条膝盖往后折的细鸟腿托着一只焦黑枪铁弩身舱，舱前竖一副上下展开 19 格的热铜反曲弓臂，鼻端上方一只 2×2 红色单眼瞄准镜，背后箭匣露出三根红羽箭尾。待机扫描：弩身左右转、红色瞄准虚线来回扫、偶尔松弦再上弦。移动是高抬腿快步。攻击：再拉一格弦，放弦时弓臂弹直、机身后坐，射出一支燃烧弩箭。技能「火焰箭」：弓弦慢慢拉到底，箭头从橙烧到白热，冷却鳍张开喷汽；火焰箭直射并留下火尾光束，插进假人停 0.2 s 后二段爆开，假人点燃。死亡是跪折崩弦：膝盖折断跪下，弓弦崩断，弓臂弹飞后平躺在地，弩身向前扑倒、冒烟后消散。SFX 为 machine/collapse/fire/beam，重量 0.5。shoot.mjs 退出码 0，compare.mjs 退出码 0，移动 gaitEvery2 前 4 帧各不相同，自检 2 轮。

巨型歼灭者：由歼灭者进化，是巨型四足反关节机甲，待机约 41×42 格。沿用鸟腿、热铜弓臂、红眼和火焰箭，腿加到 4 条并加粗；弓臂变成上下两副；单眼长成伸出机身前 3 格的眼杆，三只红眼竖排；箭匣换成背上的旋转弹鼓；机身是暗红漆装甲加枪铁骨架带。待机转鼓：弹鼓咔哒转一格，散热口喷汽，三只红眼依次亮。移动是对角两腿一组的重步，每步扬尘并有 1 格震屏。攻击：上下两副弓臂交替齐射两支火焰箭。技能：弹鼓飞转，三支箭上弦点燃，三只红眼逐个亮满；三箭扇形齐射，后坐让腿后滑 2 格；三团火在假人前、假人身上、假人后依次爆开，并留下一条地面火线（fx.wave）。死亡是过热熔化：弹鼓先烧红再烧白，然后用死亡套件 melt 塌成一滩熔铁，滴火星、冒烟后消散。SFX 为 machine/dissolve/fire/fire，重量 0.85。shoot.mjs 退出码 0，compare.mjs 退出码 0（最接近的是邪眼王，待机 IoU 0.481），移动 gaitEvery2 前 4 帧各不相同，自检 2 轮。

chars.summary: 爬行投石车，史诗，待机 36×29。木车架底下六条紫黑虫足，膝拱过车顶；木投臂斜指后上方，抛兜里兜着石弹；车尾一块发紫光的虚空晶石配重，车侧装铁绞盘。移动是极慢爬行，每帧只抬一条腿。攻击：绞盘后压投臂再猛甩，燃石走高抛物线砸到假人。技能（火炮）：地面从近到远亮起 3 个瞄准点，越远越大越亮；投臂压到水平、石弹点燃，甩出后反冲把车身抬起 2 格，燃石砸在最远的点上，有火焰外爆、大冲击环、两道地裂和碎石四溅。死亡：虫足摊平，绳断后投臂飞出去，车架起火烧焦，最后化灰（ash）。音效声明为 machine/collapse/fire/fire，重量 0.7。shoot.mjs 退出码 0，compare.mjs 退出码 0（最高待机 IoU 0.455）。移动的 gaitEvery2 前 4 个编号各不相同。一共自检 2 轮，第 2 轮把腿改成蜘蛛式膝拱，石弹换成 pale。

流浪投石机，神话，待机 30×46。爬行投石车的虫足长成四条高跷节肢，上面是漂白旧木做的 A 字机架，到处打着补丁、缠着绳、吊着碎木片。超长投臂高出机架 12 格，末端垂着巨石，机架里吊着一簇紫色晶石。整架用逐行剪切表现向前歪、摇摇欲坠。移动是高跷蹒跚，对角两条腿一组，每步震屏 1 格。攻击：配重坠落带动投臂，火焰巨石走超高弧线。技能：越晃越厉害，木板螺钉陆续崩飞，晶簇亮到 3 档；施放时配重坠下，投臂划出大弧形拖影，巨石飞出画面顶端，随后从天而降，砸出大冲击环、地裂、两侧火浪和余火。死亡：向前倾两档，转成 90° 倒地姿落地，再散架成几截（parts），晶簇滚出去后变暗。音效声明为 machine/topple/fire/meteor，重量 1.0。shoot、compare、compare --prev 退出码都是 0（最高待机 IoU 约 0.35），和爬行投石车互比也不撞脸。移动的 gaitEvery2 前 4 个编号各不相同。一共自检 2 轮。

built.feedback: 部件库目前没有机械 / 攻城器械骨架（parts-beast.md 第十二节已写明未做），所以两个角色全部是自画部件。1）parts-beast.js 暴露了 B.dropAt，但 parts-beast.md 第三节「通用」表里没有列出它的导出名，用前得先看源码确认。2）整体剪切（E.setShear）和 90° 倒地变换对塔 / 器械这类非人形很有用，但 README 没有说明 setShear。我在模块里自己写了一层落笔变换 toS，建议以后收进库，作为通用的「整体歪斜 / 倒地转向」变换。3）frames.mjs 的 --contact 参数顺序容易写错：输出文件必须紧跟在 --contact 后面。

suggestions: SKILL 施放 0.1–0.4 s：5 片环绕叶在截图里只看得清 1–2 片（叶子和白毛重叠、在身后半圈被身体挡住）。把环绕椭圆半径加大 3 格，让 5 片叶在身体轮廓外面转；叶片用 nature 第 2 级填色、第 4 级勾边，这样在白毛上面也看得出来。
IDLE：头和身体都是冷白、灰蓝勾线，头在剪影里几乎和肩连成一片。把头和颈之间的分界线加深 1 格（颈部近侧用 60 暗色 1 列），缺角左耳多伸出 1 格，让耳朵轮廓看得出平顶。
收招：变黄飘落的叶在 6_skill_after 里不明显。叶片落地前多停 2 帧，用 nature 第 3→4→5 级逐帧换色。
review.note: shoot 0 / compare 0（和已通过角色最接近：翡翠龙待机 IoU 0.655；同批最接近：黑熊 0.653）。矮壮白熊加背上三叶树苗，剪影一眼能认出；蓄力时树苗逐帧抽高，冲撞出手有前冲、弧线拖影、白色闪光和假人受击反应；侧倒死亡时树苗折断，之后消散。音效时间线对得上：step 在接触帧、swing/hit 在第 2 帧、fall 在第 11 帧。判定通过，sprite-lite.json 已复制到 accepted/PolarBear。

suggestions: ATTACK strike frame: the root sweep near the target is only a few short root tips. Make the sweep a continuous 6-8 cell horizontal root arc with a dust puff so the 'ground-launched sweep' reads better.
MOVE: add 1-2 dirt-clod particles when a root foot is pulled up to sell the 'uprooting march'.
Far-side root feet are mostly hidden behind the near legs at IDLE y=0. Pushing their outer roots 1 more cell past the near legs would strengthen the fan-shaped foot silhouette.
review.note: Review round 2. shoot exit 0 (audit passed, no sound issues). compare exit 0 (closest match is the crab warlock at idleIoU 0.528, not too similar). --prev regression check exit 0 (IoU 0.944). The previous blocking issue (root feet) is fixed: in the IDLE:0 grid, roots at y=-1..0 spread about 11 cells on the near hind foot and about 13 on the near front foot, and they read as a fan in the silhouette. The large round crown with glowing fruit, the birch-bark bear body, the hanging vines and the nose-crack sprout all match the assignment. The skill shows gold-green light particles thrown back toward the allies behind it. Death runs from yellowing leaves through collapse to wood and ash pieces. The sfx timeline lines up: step on move frames 0/4/8/12/16, swing at attack f2, hit at f4, fall at death f8. Copied to accepted/LifeTree/sprite-lite.json.

suggestions: 配色：熊毛基色 20、亮色 19 在画面里读成中棕色，名字是「黑熊」却更像棕熊（和同批暗牙的配色相似度 0.809、和黄鬃马 0.791）。把 body 材质改成 [0, 52, 52, 20]：基色用虚空紫黑 52，只有左上受光那一格用 20，颈圈毛改成 [0, 52, 20, 19]，让整只熊暗一档，禁果和熔红裂纹会更跳。
ATTACK：人立双掌高举只有第 1 帧一帧就砸下去了。把预兆拉长到 2 帧（0.083 和 0.125 s 都保持人立），出手帧再砸。
IDLE 待机个性：「扭头嗅禁果」在 1.8 s 那帧里头还是朝前，只是抬高了。让头 pitch 往后上转 2 档、鼻尖离禁果不超过 4 格，保持 3 帧。
review.note: shoot 0 / compare 0（最接近：毒龙待机 IoU 0.703，但配色只有 0.005；黄鬃马 0.697 / 0.791，都没到阈值）。蓄力人立很有特征，禁果、熔红裂纹、火线连到假人和施放时的双环都读得出来；爆裂死亡炸成熔红碎块，很有冲击力。「黑熊」读成棕熊的问题记为建议，因为这是按分配里的 boot 色阶做出来的，没有违反分配。判定通过，已复制到 accepted/BlackBear。

suggestions: 对比度：shadow 色阶 [0,52,53,54] 的蓝黑狼毛在夜景背景上几乎和背景融在一起，靠紫色刃口才看得出形状。把 body 材质的亮色从 54 换成更亮的钢蓝（59 或 60），只用在背线和头顶这类受光边上，让剪影上沿有一道亮边。
剑刃尾：尾端的上翘剑刃在待机截图里只有 2–3 格紫点。把刃身加宽到 2 格、长 6 格，刃口用 43，让「倒插的小剑」在剪影上成形。
DEATH：断角弹飞 9 格后落在假人的木桩上，和假人重叠。把弹开的方向改成向上后方，或者距离缩到 5 格。
review.note: shoot 0 / compare 0（最接近：翡翠龙 0.619；同批暗牙 0.634，配色 0.018）。瘦长低伏的狼，额头剑角和背脊锯齿鬃毛在剪影上很清楚；扑咬有低伏预兆、前扑定格和剑角上挑的拖影；技能里两道狼影交错扑咬、三道裂痕叠层，很好地表现了「狼群」。步态 4 帧各不相同，接触帧 step 声的时间对得上。判定通过，已复制到 accepted/BlackSword。

suggestions: 诅咒纹：IDLE 第 0 帧网格里，暗紫 2a 点在身侧 x=-7..4、y=-14..-11 每隔 2–3 格排成格子，画面上读成紫金相间的棋盘格或马鞍毯，不像「折线诅咒纹」。改成 3–4 道各自分开的斜折线（每道 4–5 格，逐行错 1 格，相邻两道之间至少隔 3 格金毛）。
颈圈毛：浅金颈毛在剪影上撑宽的量不到分配要求的 4 格。颈后和喉下各多伸出 2 格尖束，蓄力时再长 1 格。
IDLE 待机个性：「坐姿舔爪」在 1.8 s 那帧更像前身跃起。坐下时后腿贴地、前身竖直，抬起的前爪举到嘴下 1 格的位置保持 3 帧。
review.note: shoot 0 / compare 0（最接近：黄鬃马 0.65 / 0.772，毒龙 0.599）。和黑剑的升级线一致：剑角变成后弯弧刃加金环，剑刃尾加宽，紫眼保留，毛色从蓝黑变成金毛，体型从瘦低变成昂首健壮。短嚎的声波弧弹道、技能三圈声波、头顶诅咒印记和 12 个刻痕、假人染紫，都能读出「头狼号令叠破甲」。化灰死亡时先褪成灰白再散开。判定通过，已复制到 accepted/DarkFang。

suggestions: MOVE：长袍盖住了双脚，4 个不同帧的剪影几乎一样。让外八字方步读得出来：每步露出 1–2 格布鞋尖（交替左右），身体和钱袋左右各晃 1 格；每次 step 都在脚边加 1 颗尘土。
DEATH 8_death_down 起：肚子上那块紫色圆团带两个白点（马褂扣子高光），在躺倒的姿势里读起来像一个小幽灵。把这两颗扣子改成 gold 1 格，或者把高光去掉，让肚子只是一块鼓起的紫色衣料。
IDLE/MOVE：长袍下摆的 gold 镶边和腰后铜钱串在脚边形成金/紫棋盘格噪点。只保留下摆一行连续的 gold 镶边，铜钱串收成 3–4 枚按顺序排开的钱币。
细节：设定卡里写了圆脸双下巴，但没画出来。在下巴下沿加 1 行深一级的 skin，做出双下巴。
review.note: 第 2 轮：shoot 退出码 0（audit 没有问题，没有音效类问题，idle 29×27）；compare 退出码 0，最接近的是赌徒寡妇（idleIoU 0.623，颜色 0.087），没有撞脸；--prev 对比 review-1 退出码 0，没有部件消失。上一轮的三条阻断问题都确认改好了：(1) 算盘现在有竖向档杆、crimson 珠子和 gold 横梁，前手托在算盘下沿，不发光也能认出是算盘；(2) 钱袋改成梨形，有 gold 收口和方孔钱印记，和算盘之间留了空，不再混成一团；(3) DEATH 的 bbox 左沿是 -26（上轮是 -38），帽子没被切掉。音效时间线：step 在 f0/4/8/12/16，swing 和 shoot 在出手帧 f2，hit 在 f5 铜钱到达时，hurt 和 death 与白闪帧对齐，fall 在 f11 落地，都对得上。技能有这些表现：算盘珠亮金、金币汇入钱袋、帽珠亮紫、金币喷泉向上喷、地面金色冲击线，读得出「激进投资」。12 项都 ≥ 3，判定通过，sprite-lite 已复制到 /Users/dongdong/midnight-cabinet-pcd/pcd/accepted/Landlord/sprite-lite.json。

suggestions: 酒红锦袍几乎整块铺了 crimson 暗色和 gold 点的棋盘纹，手工色调明显超过 1/4，左上受光的两色明暗被纹样吃掉了。改成只在下摆 3 行和前襟两侧留锦纹，躯干大面积回到 band 2 的自动明暗。
技能施放帧（cast 0–0.25 s）抛出的「巨型金币」只有约 3×4 格，读不出设定写的 5 格巨币。改成 5×5 圆币：外圈 gold 描边，中心 1×1 方孔，旋转 4 帧（正 → 斜 → 侧 1 格 → 斜），落地那一帧再加 1 帧第 1 级白闪。
命中的冲击环落在角色和假人中间的空地上，假人没有任何反应。可以把巨币落点往前推到假人脚前（x≈90），或者让碎金飞溅时假人小摇一下，这样能看出这一招打到了人。
待机个性（掂金币）里，抛起的金币只有 2×2，在夜空里很容易丢。最高点那一帧加一个 3 格十字闪光。
review.note: 自动检查 shoot 退出码 0（problems 为空，idle 32×35），查重 compare 退出码 0（和最新 accepted 目录再比一次，也只命中自己）。升级线清楚：地主的瓜皮帽、帽珠、八字胡、算盘都保留了，算盘变成背后高出头顶的金框，右臂换成向前伸出身体的鎏金机关拳，剪影里「背框 + 前伸巨拳」一眼可认。步态一步重一步轻，step 的权重在 0.7 和 0.35 之间交替，和步态对得上。死亡时前扑，金手褪成铅灰（亏损）、帽子滚开，死得很有特点。sfx 的 swing/shoot 在 f2，fall 在落地帧。锦袍纹样偏噪，巨币偏小，这两处放在建议里，不算阻断。已复制到 accepted/GoldenHand。

suggestions: 和已通过的人类维京战士配色相似度 0.813（没到判重线）。两人的主材质都是蓝布，维京战士是靛蓝，海盗是墨蓝。可以把外套往更灰更旧的方向压（例如 steel/stone 暗部），或把大面积换成褪色墨绿，免得同屏时看起来像同一套衣服。
死亡时侧卧，身体向前一直躺到本地 x=+36，腿、弯刀和三角帽都压在假人木桩上。把倒地姿往后收 6–8 格（仰面朝后倒，或者跪下后向左侧卧），掉落的帽子也落在身后。
三角海盗帽的颜色是 leather 棕，帽檐两角不够翘，会读成牛仔帽。帽檐左右两个角各向上翘 2 格，再加 1 行破边缺口。
左眼眼罩和灰白髭须在 1 倍大小下几乎看不见。眼罩带斜穿过额头画 1 格 ink，髭须至少 2 行、往下垂 1 格。
review.note: 自动检查 shoot 退出码 0（problems 为空，idle 26×28），查重 compare 退出码 0（最接近的是维京战士：待机剪影重合 0.681，配色 0.813，没到判重线）。和维京战士对着看剪影是分得开的：三角帽 + 背上宝箱 + 左手铁钩 vs 角盔 + 姜红辫胡 + 大圆盾。待机回头掀宝箱偷看，个性明确；攻击先勾后捅，swing/hit 分两次落在 f2 和 f4，和两段动作对应；技能宝箱蓄光、金紫光柱冲天、金币落回箱口，从「秘密储藏」长出来，读得清。移动 4 帧换脚正常。三角帽和铁钩到暗影死神那里都保留了（铁钩长成镰刀），升级线成立。已复制到 accepted/VikingPirate。

suggestions: 墨黑斗篷（ink）在夜空深蓝背景上对比很低，待机时躯干中段几乎和背景融在一起。把斗篷亮色提一级（shadow 色阶的亮色），或者让独眼的 rimAll 轮廓光在待机时也保持 7 格内第 3 级，给左肩和兜帽边一圈淡紫。
攻击出手帧（f2）整只闪白，镰刀挥砍的拖影弧反而看不清。瞬移后的闪白挪到 f1 末尾，f2 留给过头下劈的弧形拖影（2 格宽，第 1 级），这样更贴合「过头下劈」的设定。
攻击延续的 4 帧里，镰刀一直停在身前低位，一模一样。f4–f6 让镰刃往回收 1 档角度，有个惯性回摆。
移动时烟雾下摆的 4 帧飘动幅度偏小。可以让尾端上下各错开 1 格，并在身下加 1–2 颗 shadow 色拖尾粒子（按悬浮体的移动特效规则）。
review.note: 自动检查 shoot 退出码 0（problems 为空，idle 28×37，悬浮离地），查重 compare 退出码 0（最接近的是星辉巫师，待机剪影重合 0.473）。剪影由过头弯镰和歪戴的残破三角帽撑起，一眼读出死神；海盗帽、铁钩化成的镰刀、内衬墨蓝都保留了，和维京海盗的升级线清楚。技能是亮点：蓄力时身体化成抖动的暗紫剪影，敌弹直接穿过；施放时本体闪白现身，蓝紫魂光汇回，最后十字斩打在假人上，把「闪避成功就永久变强」讲清楚了。死亡时斗篷塌成一堆布，镰刀插在地上，独眼闪两下后熄灭，最后化烟，和设定一致。悬浮体没有 step 声，sfxDecl 里写了 hover:1；fall/hit 在 t=0.967 的落地帧。整体偏暗、出手帧拖影被闪白盖掉，这两处放在建议里。已复制到 accepted/ShadowGrimReaper。

suggestions: 全部状态、近螯 + 珊瑚杖：螯和杖都是深红，和近侧腿缠在一起读成一团杂线。给近螯的钳尖加一格 pink 第 4 级高光，杖身两侧各留 1 格空，让「螯夹着杖」看得出来
螺壳：4 个紫符文现在只有 1–2 格可见。改成 2×2 并沿螺旋沟排开；再加一道深色螺旋线，壳才读得出是螺旋壳，而不是一个锥形
尖帽：帽尖只比眼柄高 1–2 格，剪影上几乎看不出。把帽尖加高 2 格，往后折的角露出轮廓（蟹巫的高尖帽由此延续）
技能施放：大泡泡外圈只有零散的几段青色。补成完整的点阵圆（每 2 格一个点），小螃蟹「从泡泡里蹦出来」才读得出
review.note: shoot 0 / compare 0（最接近翡翠龙，idle IoU 0.63），frames 正常，gaitEvery2 各不相同。音效时间线：step 在接触帧，swing/shoot 在出手帧，fall 在落地帧。这是全库第一只寄居蟹，粉色主色和同组、已通过的角色都不撞。翻倒、缩壳、只剩空壳的死亡演出很到位，召唤法阵、水柱、小螃蟹落地的技能链完整。已复制到 accepted/CrabWarlock。

suggestions: 死亡碎裂：碎块往后飞得太猛，1.2 s 时已经飞出画布左上角。把 chunks 的初速降一半，再加上落地弹跳；尖塔螺要摔成 2–3 段认得出来的螺层（螺壳色 + 紫窗），不要只是通用的 4 格碎块
技能施放：召来的巨蟹钳像一根橙色长条，下面挂着钳。钳头画成张开的两指（上下指之间留 3 格缺口），合拢那一帧再闭上，才读得出「一夹」
受击：击退和巨螯后缩都偏弱，剪影几乎不变。受击帧让整只后移 2 格，贝壳铃往前甩 2 格
水球：比例偏小（3×3），和传说档的华丽程度不配。待机加大到 4×4，并加 1 格环绕的水光点
review.note: shoot 0 / compare 0（最接近毒龙，idle IoU 0.59）。升级线一致：螺壳长成尖塔螺，尖帽变成高尖帽加贝壳铃，右螯长成巨螯，一眼能看出是蟹术士长大了。高腿横行的步态起伏明显，隔空一夹加水影钳的攻击和蟹术士的水泡连射拉得开，紫边裂隙召巨钳的技能从描述里长出来。死亡用 chunks，所以没有 fall，符合设定卡。已复制到 accepted/Crabomancer。

suggestions: 技能蓄力 / 施放：石质外壳板用 shell 亮色（17）描了一圈近白的边，再叠上 rimAll 的第 1 级白色轮廓光，施放帧整只机甲像铺了一层白噪点线框。外壳板的外沿改用 shell 第 2 级，施放帧 rim 只到第 2 级，护盾点阵再单独做白色
技能：fx.dome 护盾在施放帧被本体的白边淹没了。把护盾椭圆半径加 3 格，让它离开机体轮廓，敌弹打中时那一段变白才看得清
配色：花岗岩灰和紫核心的明度太接近，躯干读成一整块灰紫。把躯干亮面提到 stone 第 4 级，核心周围留 1 格 steel 钢圈
